<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const avatarBtn = document.getElementById('user-avatar-btn');
    const dropdownMenu = document.getElementById('user-dropdown-menu');
    const dropdownArrow = document.getElementById('user-dropdown-arrow');

    if (avatarBtn && dropdownMenu) {
      avatarBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        dropdownMenu.classList.toggle('hidden');
        if (dropdownArrow) {
          dropdownArrow.classList.toggle('rotate-180');
        }
      });

      // Close dropdown when clicking outside
      document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (!dropdownMenu.contains(e.target) && !avatarBtn.contains(e.target)) {
          dropdownMenu.classList.add('hidden');
          if (dropdownArrow) {
            dropdownArrow.classList.remove('rotate-180');
          }
        }
      });
    }
  });
</script>

      Rose: { icon: "/static/assets/image/icon/rose.svg" },
      "White/Yellow": { icon: "/static/assets/image/icon/white-yellow.svg" },
      "Yellow/White": { icon: "/static/assets/image/icon/white-yellow.svg" },
      "White/Rose": { icon: "/static/assets/image/icon/white-rose.svg" },
      "Rose/White": { icon: "/static/assets/image/icon/white-rose.svg" },
      "Yellow/Rose": { gradient: splitGradient(swatchPalette.yellow, swatchPalette.rose) },
      "Rose/Yellow": { gradient: splitGradient(swatchPalette.rose, swatchPalette.yellow) },
      Tricolor: { icon: "/static/assets/image/icon/tricolor.svg" },
      Silver: { icon: "/static/assets/image/icon/white.svg" },
      Platinum: { icon: "/static/assets/image/icon/white.svg" },
      Palladium: { icon: "/static/assets/image/icon/white.svg" },
      Black: { solid: swatchPalette.black },
      Green: { solid: swatchPalette.green },
    };

    const buildSwatch = (color) => {
      const config = swatchMap[color] || {};
      const title = String(color || "");
      let inner = "";
      if (config.icon) {
        inner = `<img class="w-full h-full rounded-full" src="${config.icon}" alt="${title}">`;
      } else if (config.gradient) {
        inner = `<span class="w-full h-full rounded-full block" style="background: ${config.gradient};"></span>`;
      } else if (config.solid) {
        inner = `<span class="w-full h-full rounded-full block" style="background: ${config.solid};"></span>`;
      } else {
        inner = `<span class="w-full h-full rounded-full block" style="background: ${swatchPalette.white};"></span>`;
      }
      return `
        <div class="w-8 h-8 p-1 rounded-[100px] cursor-pointer flex justify-start items-center gap-2.5 color-option"
          data-value="${title}" title="${title}">
          ${inner}
        </div>
      `;
    };
    
    // Clear existing options
    colorOptionsContainer.innerHTML = "";
    
    // Build new options
    normalizedColors.forEach((color) => {
      colorOptionsContainer.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", buildSwatch(color));
    });
    
    // Re-attach click listeners
    const elements = colorOptionsContainer.getElementsByClassName('color-option');
    Array.from(elements).forEach((element) => {
      const chooseColor = element.getAttribute('data-value');
      element.addEventListener('click', () => {
        updateQueryParam('color', chooseColor);
      });
    });

    if (typeof window.updateColorPreviewNote === "function") {
      window.updateColorPreviewNote();
    }
  }

  function updateQueryParam(key, value) {
    let nextValue = value;
    if (key === "finger_size") {
      if (!hasFingerSize) {
        nextValue = "";
      } else {
        const normalizedValue = normalizeFingerSizeValue(value);
        nextValue = normalizedValue || "";
      }
    }

    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
    if (nextValue === null || nextValue === undefined || nextValue === "") {
      url.searchParams.delete(key);
    } else {
      url.searchParams.set(key, nextValue);
    }
    window.history.replaceState({}, "", url.toString());
    if (nextValue === null || nextValue === undefined || nextValue === "") {
      searchParams.delete(key);
    } else {
      searchParams.set(key, nextValue);
    }

    if (!window.selectedOptions) {
      window.selectedOptions = {};
    }

    const updateText = (id, nextValue) => {
      const target = document.getElementById(id);
      if (target) {
        target.textContent = nextValue || "";
      }
    };

    switch (key) {
      case "metal":
        window.selectedOptions.metal = value;
        updateText("metal-value", value);
        
        if (typeof window.updateMetalChecked === "function") {
          window.updateMetalChecked(value);
        }
        
        if (typeof window.updateColorState === "function") {
          window.updateColorState(value);
        }
        break;
      case "color":
        window.selectedOptions.color = value;
        if (typeof window.updateColorUI === "function") {
          window.updateColorUI(value);
        }
        if (typeof window.updateProductMedia === "function") {
          window.updateProductMedia(value);
        }
        break;
      case "level":
        window.selectedOptions.level = value;
        const levelDisplayValue = isL0Style && value === "Polished" ? "Complete" : value;
        updateText("level-value", levelDisplayValue);
        if (typeof window.updateDiamondQualityState === "function") {
          window.updateDiamondQualityState(value);
        }
        if (typeof window.updateCenterStoneStatus === "function") {
          window.updateCenterStoneStatus(value);
        }
        if (typeof window.updatePegHeadStatus === "function") {
          window.updatePegHeadStatus(window.pegHeadSelected === true);
        }
        if (typeof window.updateLevelCenterLabels === "function") {
          window.updateLevelCenterLabels();
        }
        if (typeof window.updateLevelWeight === "function") {
          window.updateLevelWeight(value);
        }
        if (typeof window.updateMeleeBreakdown === "function" && window.initialStoneBreakdown) {
          window.updateMeleeBreakdown(window.initialStoneBreakdown);
        }

        if (typeof window.updateLevelChecked === "function") {
          window.updateLevelChecked(value);
        }
        break;
      case "quality":
        window.selectedOptions.quality = value;
        if (typeof window.formatQualityLabel === "function") {
          updateText("quality-value", window.formatQualityLabel(value));
        } else {
          updateText("quality-value", value);
        }

        if (typeof window.updateQualityChecked === "function") {
          window.updateQualityChecked(value);
        }
        break;
      case "finger_size":

        window.selectedOptions.finger_size = nextValue;

        break;
      case "additional_details":
        window.selectedOptions.additional_details = value;
        if (typeof window.updateNotesValue === "function") {
          window.updateNotesValue(value);
        }
        break;
      case "engraving":
        window.selectedOptions.engraving = value;
        if (typeof window.updateEngravingValue === "function") {
          window.updateEngravingValue(value);
        }
        break;
      case "engravingfont":
        window.selectedOptions.engravingfont = value;
        if (typeof window.updateEngravingFontValue === "function") {
          window.updateEngravingFontValue(value);
        }
        break;
      default:
        window.selectedOptions[key] = value;
        break;
    }

    if (typeof window.schedulePriceUpdate === "function") {
      window.schedulePriceUpdate();
    } else if (typeof window.fetchPriceDueDate === "function" && !window.suspendPriceUpdate) {
      window.fetchPriceDueDate();
    }
    if (typeof checkinstock === "function") {
      checkinstock();
    }
  }

  function resolveSelection(paramValue, options, fallback) {
    if (!Array.isArray(options) || options.length === 0) {
      return fallback || paramValue || "";
    }
    if (paramValue && options.includes(paramValue)) {
      return paramValue;
    }
    if (fallback && options.includes(fallback)) {
      return fallback;
    }
    return options[0];
  }

  const availableColors = filterColorOptions(['White', 'Yellow', 'Rose', 'Silver', 'Platinum', 'Palladium']);
  const availableMetals = ['10 KT', '14 KT', '18 KT', 'Silver', 'Platinum', 'Palladium', '14 KT Palladium', '18 KT Palladium'];
  const rawLevels = ['Polished', 'Clip & Ship'];
  const availableLevels = rawLevels;
  window.availableColors = availableColors;
  window.productCollections = Array.isArray(collections) ? collections : [];
  window.productSoldAsPair = soldAsPair;

  function updatePairState(nextData) {
    const nextCollections = Array.isArray(nextData?.collections)
      ? nextData.collections
      : window.productCollections;
    const nextSoldAsPair = typeof nextData?.sold_as_pair === "boolean"
      ? nextData.sold_as_pair
      : window.productSoldAsPair;
    const isEarringProduct = Array.isArray(nextCollections)
      ? nextCollections.includes("Earrings")
      : false;

    window.productCollections = nextCollections;
    window.productSoldAsPair = nextSoldAsPair;
    window.isEarringProduct = isEarringProduct;
    window.isEarringPair = isEarringProduct && nextSoldAsPair;

    const pairWarning = document.getElementById("pair-warning");
    if (pairWarning) {
      const showWarning = isEarringProduct && !nextSoldAsPair;
      pairWarning.hidden = !showWarning;
      pairWarning.classList.toggle("hidden", !showWarning);
    }

    const cartButton = document.getElementById("cart-button");
    if (cartButton) {
      cartButton.dataset.soldAsPair = nextSoldAsPair ? "1" : "0";
    }

    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("pair:updated"));
  }

  window.updatePairState = updatePairState;
  updatePairState({ collections, sold_as_pair: soldAsPair });

  if (window.productVariants && Array.isArray(window.productVariants)) {
    const sStyleMetalSet = new Set();
    const metalNameRegex = /(\b\d+\s*KT\b|\bPlatinum\b|\bSilver\b|\bPalladium\b)/i;
    window.productVariants.forEach((variant) => {
      const metalField = String(variant?.metal || "").trim();
      if (metalField) {
        sStyleMetalSet.add(metalField);
        return;
      }
      const variantName = String(variant?.variant_name || "");
      const match = variantName.match(metalNameRegex);
      if (match) {
        sStyleMetalSet.add(match[1].replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim());
      }
    });
    const sStyleMetals = Array.from(sStyleMetalSet);
    if (sStyleMetals.length) {
      window.availableMetalsOverride = sStyleMetals;
      if (typeof window.rebuildMetalOptions === "function") {
        window.rebuildMetalOptions(sStyleMetals);
      }
    }
  }

  function initializeColorOptions() {
    if (typeof rebuildColorOptions !== "function") {
      return;
    }

    let resolvedColors = filterColorOptions(availableColors);

    if (Array.isArray(window.availableColorsOverride) && window.availableColorsOverride.length) {
      resolvedColors = window.availableColorsOverride;
    } else if (window.productVariants && Array.isArray(window.productVariants)) {
      const variantColors = new Set();

      // Color code to name mapping (from Color model)
      const colorCodeMap = {
        'Y': 'Yellow',
        'W': 'White',
        'K': 'Rose',
        'L': 'Black',
        'R': 'White/Rose',
        'T': 'White/Yellow',
        'M': 'Yellow/Rose',
        'U': 'Yellow/White',
        'V': 'Rose/White',
        'P': 'Platinum',
        'A': 'Palladium',
        'S': 'Silver',
        'I': 'Titanium',
        'G': 'Green',
        '3': 'Tricolor'
      };

      window.productVariants.forEach((variant) => {
        const variantName = variant.variant_name || '';
        // For 14kt/18kt variants, color is in the last character of style_number
        if (/14kt|18kt/.test(variantName)) {
          const colorCode = variant.style_number?.slice(-1);
          const colorName = colorCodeMap[colorCode];
          if (colorName) {
            variantColors.add(colorName);
          }
        }
      });

      const allColors = filterColorOptions(Array.from(variantColors));
      if (allColors.length > 0) {
        resolvedColors = allColors;
      }
    }

    rebuildColorOptions(resolvedColors);

    const currentColor =
      searchParams.get("color") || window.selectedOptions?.color || currentdefaults[1] || "";
    if (currentColor && typeof window.updateColorUI === "function") {
      // White-metal colors (Platinum/Silver/Palladium) are canonical values;
      // updateColorUI maps them to the White swatch for display.
      window.updateColorUI(currentColor);
    }

    const currentMetal =
      searchParams.get("metal") || window.selectedOptions?.metal || currentdefaults[0] || "";
    if (currentMetal && typeof window.updateColorState === "function") {
      window.updateColorState(currentMetal);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeColorOptions, { once: true });
  } else {
    initializeColorOptions();
  }

  const queryColorParam = searchParams.get("color");
  const queryMetalParam = searchParams.get("metal");
  const queryLevelParam = searchParams.get("level");
  const queryVariantParam = searchParams.get("variant");

  const defaultColorCandidate = currentdefaults[1] || "";
  const defaultColor = excludedColorOptions.has(defaultColorCandidate)
    ? (availableColors[0] || defaultColorCandidate || "White")
    : (defaultColorCandidate || (availableColors[0] || ""));
  const defaultMetal = currentdefaults[0] || (availableMetals[0] || "");
  let defaultLevel = currentdefaults[2] || (availableLevels[0] || "");
  if (isL0Style) {
    defaultLevel = "Polished";
  }

  const queryColor = resolveSelection(queryColorParam, availableColors, defaultColor);
  const selectedMetal = resolveSelection(queryMetalParam, availableMetals, defaultMetal);
  const selectedLevel = resolveSelection(queryLevelParam, availableLevels, defaultLevel);

  // Variants are safely embedded via Django json_script
  const productVariants = JSON.parse(
    document.getElementById("product-variants").textContent
  );
  window.productVariants = productVariants;
  const inventoryData = JSON.parse(
    document.getElementById("product-inventory").textContent || "[]"
  );
  window.stocked = Array.isArray(inventoryData) ? inventoryData : [];
  


  function parseVariantName(variantName) {
    if (!variantName || typeof variantName !== "string") {
      return {
        variant: null,
        fingerSize: "",
        rawFingerSize: "",
        ptValue: "",
        rawPtValue: "",
      };
    }

    const trimmed = variantName.trim();
    const ptMatch = trimmed.match(/(\d*\.?\d+|\.\d+)\s*PT\b/i);
    const rawPt = ptMatch ? ptMatch[1] : "";
    const normalizedPt = rawPt ? normalizePtValue(rawPt) : "";
    const sizeMatch = trimmed.match(/size\s*([0-9]+(?:\.\d+)?)/i);
    let rawSize = sizeMatch ? sizeMatch[1] : "";
    let normalizedSize = rawSize ? normalizeFingerSizeValue(rawSize) : "";
    const parts = trimmed.split(",").map((entry) => entry.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    let variantLabel = parts[0] || trimmed;

    if (!rawSize) {
      // Match a standalone S-size token (e.g. "S7", ".10S7.5", ", S5") but not an "S" that is
      // the trailing letter of a word (e.g. "Fits 1/4 to 1 Ct."), which is prose, not a size.
      // A captured non-letter prefix is used instead of a lookbehind for older-browser safety.
      const sSizeMatch = trimmed.match(/(^|[^A-Za-z])S\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(?!\s*mm)\b/i);
      if (sSizeMatch) {
        rawSize = sSizeMatch[2];
        normalizedSize = rawSize ? normalizeFingerSizeValue(rawSize) : "";
        if (parts.length <= 1) {
          const candidate = trimmed
            .slice(0, sSizeMatch.index + sSizeMatch[1].length)
            .trim()
            .replace(/[-,\s]+$/, "")
            .trim();
          if (candidate) {
            variantLabel = candidate;
          } else {
            variantLabel = "Size";
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      variant: variantLabel || trimmed,
      fingerSize: normalizedSize,
      rawFingerSize: rawSize,
      ptValue: normalizedPt,
      rawPtValue: rawPt,
    };
  }

  function isMmVariantName(variantName) {
    const lower = String(variantName || "").toLowerCase();
    if (!lower) {
      return false;
    }
    if (/size\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?/.test(lower)) {
      return false;
    }
    if (/\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?:mm)?\s*[x×]\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?:mm)?/.test(lower)) {
      return true;
    }
    return /\bmm\b/.test(lower);
  }

  function normalizeFingerSizeValue(value) {
    const numericValue = Number(value);
    if (Number.isNaN(numericValue) || numericValue <= 0) {
      return "";
    }
    return numericValue.toFixed(2);
  }

  // Digits after a style number's last "S" are only a finger size when they fall in
  // the range the store sells (3-13.5 in the catalog today; 2-16 leaves headroom).
  // Larger numbers are style identifiers that happen to follow an "S", e.g. the
  // "S18097" in "NS18097H-8MM".
  function isPlausibleFingerSize(value) {
    const numericValue = Number(value);
    if (Number.isNaN(numericValue)) {
      return false;
    }
    return numericValue >= 2 && numericValue <= 16;
  }

  function normalizePtValue(value) {
    const numericValue = Number(value);
    if (Number.isNaN(numericValue)) {
      return "";
    }
    return String(numericValue);
  }

  function getStyleBaseFromNumber(styleNumber) {
    const normalized = String(styleNumber || "");
    const lastIndex = normalized.lastIndexOf("S");
    if (lastIndex === -1) {
      return "";
    }
    return normalized.slice(0, lastIndex + 1);
  }

  function getStyleSuffixFromNumber(styleNumber) {
    const normalized = String(styleNumber || "");
    const lastIndex = normalized.lastIndexOf("S");
    if (lastIndex === -1) {
      return "";
    }
    const after = normalized.slice(lastIndex + 1);
    const sizeMatch = after.match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
    if (!sizeMatch) {
      return "";
    }
    return after.slice(sizeMatch[1].length) || "";
  }

  function buildFingerSizeLookup(variantsList) {
    const lookup = {};
    (variantsList || []).forEach((entry) => {
      const variantName = entry?.variant_name || "";
      if (isMmVariantName(variantName)) {
        return;
      }
      const styleNumber = String(entry?.style_number || "");
      const lastIndex = styleNumber.lastIndexOf("S");
      if (lastIndex === -1) {
        return;
      }
      const base = styleNumber.slice(0, lastIndex + 1);
      const after = styleNumber.slice(lastIndex + 1);
      const sizeMatch = after.match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
      if (!sizeMatch || !isPlausibleFingerSize(sizeMatch[1])) {
        return;
      }
      const rawSize = sizeMatch[1];
      const normalized = normalizeFingerSizeValue(rawSize);
      if (!normalized) {
        return;
      }
      if (!lookup[base]) {
        lookup[base] = { sizes: new Set(), rawByNormalized: {} };
      }
      lookup[base].sizes.add(normalized);
      if (!lookup[base].rawByNormalized[normalized]) {
        lookup[base].rawByNormalized[normalized] = rawSize;
      }
    });
    Object.keys(lookup).forEach((base) => {
      lookup[base].sizes = Array.from(lookup[base].sizes).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
    });
    return lookup;
  }

  function extractFingerSizesFromVariantStyles(variantsList) {
    const sizes = new Set();
    (variantsList || []).forEach((entry) => {
      const variantName = entry?.variant_name || "";
      if (isMmVariantName(variantName)) {
        return;
      }
      const styleNumber = String(entry?.style_number || "");
      const lastIndex = styleNumber.lastIndexOf("S");
      if (lastIndex === -1) {
        return;
      }
      const after = styleNumber.slice(lastIndex + 1);
      const match = after.match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
      if (!match || !isPlausibleFingerSize(match[1])) {
        return;
      }
      const normalized = normalizeFingerSizeValue(match[1]);
      if (normalized) {
        sizes.add(normalized);
      }
    });
    return Array.from(sizes).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
  }

  function extractFingerSizesFromVariantNames(variantsList) {
    const sizes = new Set();
    (variantsList || []).forEach((entry) => {
      const variantName = entry?.variant_name || "";
      const parsed = parseVariantName(variantName);
      if (parsed.fingerSize) {
        sizes.add(parsed.fingerSize);
      }
    });
    return Array.from(sizes).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
  }

  function extractFingerSizeFromStyleNumber(styleNumber) {
    const normalized = String(styleNumber || "");
    const lastIndex = normalized.lastIndexOf("S");
    if (lastIndex === -1) {
      return "";
    }
    const after = normalized.slice(lastIndex + 1);
    const match = after.match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
    if (!match || !isPlausibleFingerSize(match[1])) {
      return "";
    }
    return normalizeFingerSizeValue(match[1]) || "";
  }

  function extractFingerSizesFromInventory(inventoryList) {
    const sizes = new Set();
    (inventoryList || []).forEach((entry) => {
      const rawValue = entry?.finger_size;
      if (!rawValue || ["None", "N/A"].includes(String(rawValue))) {
        return;
      }
      const normalized = normalizeFingerSizeValue(rawValue);
      if (normalized) {
        sizes.add(normalized);
      }
    });
    return Array.from(sizes).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
  }

  // A style is size-suffixed only when its last "S" token parses to a plausible finger size.
  const isSStyleNumber = (styleValue) => extractFingerSizeFromStyleNumber(styleValue) !== "";
  const hasSStyleVariants = productVariants.some((entry) => isSStyleNumber(entry?.style_number));
  const variantsSet = new Set();

  for (const v of productVariants) {
    const variantLabel = v.variant_name ? v.variant_name.trim() : "";
    if (!variantLabel) {
      continue;
    }
    if (hasSStyleVariants) {
      const parsed = parseVariantName(variantLabel);
      const baseLabel = String(parsed.variant || "").trim();
      if (baseLabel) {
        variantsSet.add(baseLabel);
      }
    } else {
      variantsSet.add(variantLabel);
    }
  }

  const variants = Array.from(variantsSet);
  const defaultVariant = "10X8 MM";
  const normalizedQueryVariantParam = queryVariantParam ? queryVariantParam.trim() : "";
  const normalizedDefaultVariant = defaultVariant ? defaultVariant.trim() : "";
  const normalizedQueryBase = hasSStyleVariants && normalizedQueryVariantParam
    ? String(parseVariantName(normalizedQueryVariantParam).variant || normalizedQueryVariantParam).trim()
    : normalizedQueryVariantParam;
  const normalizedDefaultBase = hasSStyleVariants && normalizedDefaultVariant
    ? String(parseVariantName(normalizedDefaultVariant).variant || normalizedDefaultVariant).trim()
    : normalizedDefaultVariant;
  const selectedVariant = resolveSelection(normalizedQueryBase, variants, normalizedDefaultBase);
  const parsedSelectedVariant = parseVariantName(selectedVariant);
  const parsedInitialVariant = parseVariantName(normalizedQueryVariantParam || normalizedDefaultVariant);
  const styleNumberFingerSize = hasSStyleVariants
    ? extractFingerSizeFromStyleNumber("10002\u002D10X8")
    : "";
  const normalizedDefaultFingerSize = normalizeFingerSizeValue(currentdefaults[4] || "");
  const rawQueryFingerSize = normalizeFingerSizeValue(searchParams.get("finger_size") || "");
  const queryFingerSizeMatchesStyle =
    hasSStyleVariants && styleNumberFingerSize && rawQueryFingerSize
      ? rawQueryFingerSize === styleNumberFingerSize
      : Boolean(rawQueryFingerSize);
  const normalizedQueryFingerSize = queryFingerSizeMatchesStyle ? rawQueryFingerSize : "";
  const initialVariantFingerSize =
    parsedInitialVariant.fingerSize || parsedSelectedVariant.fingerSize || "";
  let resolvedInitialFingerSize = hasSStyleVariants
    ? (normalizedQueryFingerSize || initialVariantFingerSize || styleNumberFingerSize || normalizedDefaultFingerSize)
    : (normalizedQueryFingerSize || normalizedDefaultFingerSize || initialVariantFingerSize || styleNumberFingerSize);
  const deferFingerSizeSelection = hasSStyleVariants && !normalizedQueryFingerSize;
  if (deferFingerSizeSelection) {
    resolvedInitialFingerSize = "";
  }
  if (resolvedInitialFingerSize) {
    currentdefaults[4] = resolvedInitialFingerSize;
  }
  window.initialFingerSize = resolvedInitialFingerSize || "";
  window.deferFingerSizeSelection = deferFingerSizeSelection;

  function findVariantTarget(variantValue) {
    if (!variantValue) {
      return null;
    }
    const normalized = variantValue.trim();
    for (const entry of productVariants) {
      const entryName = entry?.variant_name ? entry.variant_name.trim() : "";
      const entryStyle = entry?.style_number ? String(entry.style_number).trim() : "";
      if (entryName === normalized || entryStyle === normalized) {
        return entry;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function findVariantTargetBySize(variantValue, fingerSize) {
    if (!variantValue || !fingerSize) {
      return null;
    }
    const parsedSelected = parseVariantName(variantValue);
    const targetVariant = String(parsedSelected.variant || "").trim();
    const normalizedSize = normalizeFingerSizeValue(fingerSize);
    if (!targetVariant || !normalizedSize) {
      return null;
    }
    const isSizeOnlyVariant = /^size\b/i.test(targetVariant) && parsedSelected.fingerSize;
    for (const entry of productVariants) {
      const entryName = entry?.variant_name ? entry.variant_name.trim() : "";
      if (!entryName) {
        continue;
      }
      const parsedEntry = parseVariantName(entryName);
      if (!isSizeOnlyVariant) {
        if (String(parsedEntry.variant || "").trim() !== targetVariant) {
          continue;
        }
      } else if (!/^size\b/i.test(String(parsedEntry.variant || "").trim())) {
        continue;
      }
      if (normalizeFingerSizeValue(parsedEntry.fingerSize) === normalizedSize) {
        return entry;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  const fingerSizeLookup = buildFingerSizeLookup(productVariants);
  window.fingerSizeLookup = fingerSizeLookup;
  const fingerSizesFromVariantStyles = extractFingerSizesFromVariantStyles(productVariants);
  const fingerSizesFromVariantNames = extractFingerSizesFromVariantNames(productVariants);
  let fingerSizes = Array.from(new Set([
    ...fingerSizesFromVariantStyles,
    ...fingerSizesFromVariantNames,
  ])).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
  window.fingerSizes = fingerSizes;

  currentdefaults[0] = selectedMetal || currentdefaults[0];
  currentdefaults[1] = queryColor || currentdefaults[1];
  currentdefaults[2] = selectedLevel || currentdefaults[2];

  window.selectedOptions = {
    metal: selectedMetal,
    color: queryColor,
    level: selectedLevel,
    variant: selectedVariant,
    style_number: "10002-10X8",
    finger_size: normalizeFingerSizeValue(currentdefaults[4] || ""),
  };
  window.findVariantTarget = findVariantTarget;

  window.renderStockPopup = function renderStockPopup(inventory) {
    const holder = document.getElementById("stockholder");
    const updateStockSummary = (items) => {
      const count = Array.isArray(items) ? items.length : 0;
      const status = document.getElementById("instock-status");
      const dot = document.getElementById("instock-dot");
      const countWrap = document.getElementById("instock-count");
      const countValue = document.getElementById("instock-count-value");
      const countPlural = document.getElementById("instock-count-plural");

      if (status) {
        status.textContent = count > 0 ? "In Stock" : "Made to Order";
      }
      if (dot) {
        dot.classList.toggle("hidden", count === 0);
      }
      if (countWrap) {
        countWrap.classList.toggle("hidden", count === 0);
      }
      if (countValue) {
        countValue.textContent = String(count);
      }
      if (countPlural) {
        countPlural.textContent = count === 1 ? "" : "s";
      }
    };

    updateStockSummary(inventory);

    if (!holder) {
      return;
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(inventory) || inventory.length === 0) {
      holder.innerHTML = "<div class=\"p-4 text-sm text-slate-500\">No in-stock options available.</div>";
      return;
    }

    let table =
      '<div><table border="0" class="stocktable"><thead><tr>' +
      "<th>Metal</th><th>Color</th><th>Finish Level</th><th>Stone Quality</th><th>Size</th><th>Qty</th><th></th>" +
      "</tr></thead><tbody>";

    inventory.forEach((entry, index) => {
      const quality = entry.quality && entry.quality !== "" ? entry.quality : "N/A";
      const size = entry.finger_size && !Number.isNaN(Number(entry.finger_size))
        ? Number(entry.finger_size).toFixed(2)
        : "N/A";
      const levelText = "10" === "L0" ? "Complete" : entry.level;
      const colorText = (entry.color || "")
        .replace(/(Silver|Platinum|Palladium)/g, "White")
        .replace("/", "​/​");

      table +=
        "<tr><td>" + entry.metal + "</td><td>" + colorText + "</td><td>" + levelText +
        "</td><td>" + quality.replace(" Grown", "").replace("E/F/G", "D/E/F") + "</td><td>" + size +
        "</td><td>" + entry.quantity +
        '</td><td><button type="button" class="popupsubmit choosebutton" data-stock-index="' + index + '">Select</button></td></tr>';
    });

    table += "</tbody></table></div>";
    holder.innerHTML = table;

    holder.querySelectorAll("[data-stock-index]").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        const index = Number(button.dataset.stockIndex);
        const entry = inventory[index];
        if (!entry) {
          return;
        }

        const availableColors = window.availableColors || [];
        const fallbackColor = window.selectedOptions?.color || availableColors[0] || entry.color;
        const colorValue = availableColors.includes(entry.color) ? entry.color : fallbackColor;
        const resolvedFingerSize =
          entry.finger_size && !Number.isNaN(Number(entry.finger_size))
            ? Number(entry.finger_size).toFixed(2)
            : "";

        if (typeof window.batchUpdateQueryParams === "function") {
          window.batchUpdateQueryParams({
            metal: entry.metal || "",
            color: colorValue || "",
            level: entry.level || "",
            quality:
              entry.quality && entry.quality !== "N/A" && entry.quality !== "None"
                ? entry.quality
                : "",
            finger_size: resolvedFingerSize || "",
          });
        } else if (typeof updateQueryParam === "function") {
          updateQueryParam("metal", entry.metal || "");
          updateQueryParam("color", colorValue || "");
          updateQueryParam("level", entry.level || "");
          if (entry.quality && entry.quality !== "N/A" && entry.quality !== "None") {
            updateQueryParam("quality", entry.quality);
          } else {
            updateQueryParam("quality", "");
          }
          updateQueryParam("finger_size", resolvedFingerSize || "");
        }

        if (typeof window.updateFingerSizeInput === "function" && resolvedFingerSize) {
          window.updateFingerSizeInput(window.fingerSizes || [], resolvedFingerSize);
        }

        if (typeof popdown === "function") {
          popdown("popstock");
        }
      });
    });
  };

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const trigger = document.getElementById("instock-trigger");
    if (trigger) {
      trigger.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (typeof popup === "function") {
          popup("popstock");
        }
      });
    }
    window.renderStockPopup(window.stocked);
  });

  function parseStoneDimensionValue(value) {
    if (!value || typeof value !== "string") {
      return null;
    }
    const parts = value.replace(" mm", "").split(" x ");
    if (parts.length < 2) {
      return null;
    }
    const length = parseFloat(parts[0]);
    const width = parseFloat(parts[1]);
    if (Number.isNaN(length) || Number.isNaN(width)) {
      return null;
    }
    return [length, width];
  }

  function pickCenterStone(stoneBreakdown) {
    if (!Array.isArray(stoneBreakdown) || !stoneBreakdown.length) {
      return null;
    }
    // Legacy behavior: use the first entry without checking for a center flag.
    return stoneBreakdown[0];
  }

  function isStoneSizeCompatible(targetSize, selectedSize, tolerance = 0.15) {
    if (!targetSize || !selectedSize) {
      return false;
    }
    return (
      targetSize[0] >= selectedSize[0] - tolerance &&
      targetSize[0] <= selectedSize[0] + tolerance &&
      targetSize[1] >= selectedSize[1] - tolerance &&
      targetSize[1] <= selectedSize[1] + tolerance
    );
  }

  window.applyVariantData = async function applyVariantData(variantValue, options = {}) {
    const previousOptions = window.selectedOptions ? { ...window.selectedOptions } : null;
    const previousVariant = previousOptions?.variant || "";
    const previousSearch = window.location.search;
    const skipCenterRangeCheck = options?.skipCenterRangeCheck === true;
    const preserveSelections = options?.preserveSelections === true;
    let shouldFetchPrice = true;

    let target = findVariantTarget(variantValue);
    if (!target) {
      const currentSize = normalizeFingerSizeValue(window.selectedOptions?.finger_size || currentdefaults[4] || "");
      target = findVariantTargetBySize(variantValue, currentSize);
    }
    if (!target || !target.style_number) {
      return;
    }

    let resolvedVariantValue = target?.variant_name ? String(target.variant_name).trim() : variantValue;
    const parsedVariant = parseVariantName(resolvedVariantValue);
    const parsedFingerSize = parsedVariant?.fingerSize || "";
    const lookup = window.fingerSizeLookup || buildFingerSizeLookup(productVariants);
    const baseStyle = getStyleBaseFromNumber(target.style_number);
    const styleSuffix = getStyleSuffixFromNumber(target.style_number);
    const sizeOptionsForBase = baseStyle && lookup[baseStyle] ? (lookup[baseStyle].sizes || []) : [];
    const rawSizeMap = baseStyle && lookup[baseStyle] ? (lookup[baseStyle].rawByNormalized || {}) : {};
    let resolvedStyleNumber = target.style_number;
    let resolvedFingerSize = "";
    if (baseStyle && sizeOptionsForBase.length) {
      const urlSize = normalizeFingerSizeValue(new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("finger_size"));
      const explicitSize = normalizeFingerSizeValue(window.selectedOptions?.finger_size || "");
      const fallbackSize = normalizeFingerSizeValue(currentdefaults[4] || "");
      const preferredParsedSize = parsedFingerSize && sizeOptionsForBase.includes(parsedFingerSize)
        ? parsedFingerSize
        : "";
      resolvedFingerSize = (explicitSize && sizeOptionsForBase.includes(explicitSize))
        ? explicitSize
        : (sizeOptionsForBase.includes(urlSize)
          ? urlSize
          : (sizeOptionsForBase.includes(fallbackSize)
            ? fallbackSize
            : (preferredParsedSize || sizeOptionsForBase[0])));
      const rawSize = rawSizeMap[resolvedFingerSize] || String(Number(resolvedFingerSize));
      resolvedStyleNumber = `${baseStyle}${rawSize}${styleSuffix}`;
      const matchedEntry = findVariantTargetBySize(resolvedVariantValue, resolvedFingerSize);
      if (matchedEntry?.style_number) {
        resolvedStyleNumber = matchedEntry.style_number;
        if (matchedEntry.variant_name && matchedEntry.variant_name !== resolvedVariantValue) {
          resolvedVariantValue = matchedEntry.variant_name;
        }
      }
      window.fingerSizes = sizeOptionsForBase;
      if (typeof window.updateFingerSizeInput === "function") {
        window.updateFingerSizeInput(sizeOptionsForBase, resolvedFingerSize);
      }
    } else if (parsedFingerSize) {
      resolvedFingerSize = parsedFingerSize;
      const matchedEntry = findVariantTargetBySize(resolvedVariantValue, resolvedFingerSize);
      if (matchedEntry?.style_number) {
        resolvedStyleNumber = matchedEntry.style_number;
        if (matchedEntry.variant_name && matchedEntry.variant_name !== resolvedVariantValue) {
          resolvedVariantValue = matchedEntry.variant_name;
        }
      }
    }

    if (typeof window.updateFingerSizeOptionsForVariant === "function") {
      window.updateFingerSizeOptionsForVariant(resolvedVariantValue);
    }

    const normalizedResolvedFingerSize = hasFingerSize ? normalizeFingerSizeValue(resolvedFingerSize || "") : "";

    if (window.selectedOptions) {
      window.selectedOptions.style_number = resolvedStyleNumber;
      if (hasFingerSize) {
        window.selectedOptions.finger_size = normalizedResolvedFingerSize;
      }
      window.selectedOptions.variant = resolvedVariantValue;
    } else {
      window.selectedOptions = { style_number: resolvedStyleNumber };
      if (hasFingerSize) {
        window.selectedOptions.finger_size = normalizedResolvedFingerSize;
      }
      window.selectedOptions.variant = resolvedVariantValue;
    }
    const cartButton = document.getElementById("cart-button");
    if (cartButton) {
      cartButton.dataset.styleNumber = resolvedStyleNumber;
    }
    const styleNumberBadge = document.getElementById("product-style-number");
    if (styleNumberBadge) {
      styleNumberBadge.textContent = resolvedStyleNumber;
    }
    if (typeof window.updateVariantUI === "function") {
      window.updateVariantUI(resolvedVariantValue);
    }
    if (typeof window.updateMensBandsVariantUI === "function") {
      window.updateMensBandsVariantUI(resolvedVariantValue, resolvedStyleNumber);
    }
    const styleParam = resolvedStyleNumber.replace("/", "--");
    const response = await fetch(`/api/product/${styleParam}/?format=json`);
    if (!response.ok) {
      return;
    }
    const productData = await response.json();

    if (!skipCenterRangeCheck && Array.isArray(window.chosendiamond) && window.chosendiamond.length > 0) {
      let targetSize = null;
      try {
        const centerStone = pickCenterStone(productData?.stone_breakdown);
        targetSize = parseStoneDimensionValue(centerStone?.dimension || "");
      } catch (e) {
        targetSize = null;
      }
      const selectedSize = parseStoneDimensionValue(window.chosendiamond[5]);

      if (targetSize) {
        if (!isStoneSizeCompatible(targetSize, selectedSize)) {
          const shouldContinue = window.confirm(
            "The center stone size for the selected product is not within your center stone's range. Would you like to continue to this product and discard your center stone?"
          );
          if (!shouldContinue) {
            if (previousVariant) {
              window.applyVariantData(previousVariant, { skipCenterRangeCheck: true });
            } else {
              window.history.replaceState({}, "", `${window.location.pathname}${previousSearch}`);
            }
            return;
          }
          if (typeof window.clearCenterStoneSelection === "function") {
            window.clearCenterStoneSelection();
          } else if (typeof unsetdiamond === "function") {
            unsetdiamond();
          }
          if (typeof window.clearMatchingStoneSelection === "function") {
            window.clearMatchingStoneSelection();
          }
        }
      } else {
        const shouldContinue = window.confirm(
          "The selected product does not have a specified center stone size. Would you like to continue to this product and discard your center stone?"
        );
        if (!shouldContinue) {
          if (previousVariant) {
            window.applyVariantData(previousVariant, { skipCenterRangeCheck: true });
          } else {
            window.history.replaceState({}, "", `${window.location.pathname}${previousSearch}`);
          }
          return;
        }
        if (typeof window.clearCenterStoneSelection === "function") {
          window.clearCenterStoneSelection();
        } else if (typeof unsetdiamond === "function") {
          unsetdiamond();
        }
        if (typeof window.clearMatchingStoneSelection === "function") {
          window.clearMatchingStoneSelection();
        }
      }
    }

    if (productData) {
      const nextTitle = String(productData.title || "");
      if (nextTitle) {
        const titleEl = document.getElementById("product-title");
        if (titleEl) {
          titleEl.textContent = nextTitle;
        }
        document.title = nextTitle;
      }

      const nextImages = Array.isArray(productData.images) ? productData.images : [];
      const nextVideos = Array.isArray(productData.videos) ? productData.videos : [];
      const imagesScript = document.getElementById("product-images");
      if (imagesScript) {
        imagesScript.textContent = JSON.stringify(nextImages);
      }
      const videosScript = document.getElementById("product-videos");
      if (videosScript) {
        videosScript.textContent = JSON.stringify(nextVideos);
      }
      window.fileURLs = [...nextImages, ...nextVideos];

      const cartButton = document.getElementById("cart-button");
      if (cartButton) {
        if (nextTitle) {
          cartButton.dataset.productTitle = nextTitle;
        }
        if (nextImages[0]) {
          cartButton.dataset.productImage = nextImages[0];
        }
      }

      const selectedColor = window.selectedOptions?.color || "";
      if (typeof window.setProductMedia === "function") {
        window.setProductMedia(nextImages, nextVideos, selectedColor);
      } else if (typeof window.updateProductMedia === "function") {
        window.updateProductMedia(selectedColor);
      }
      if (typeof window.updateColorPreviewNote === "function") {
        window.updateColorPreviewNote();
      }
    }

    if (typeof window.updatePairState === "function") {
      window.updatePairState(productData);
    }

    // Update metal/color/level/quality from product JSON (v1 parity)
    if (productData && !preserveSelections) {
      const metalOptions = Array.isArray(productData.metals) ? productData.metals : [];
      const colorOptions = Array.isArray(productData.colors) ? productData.colors : [];
      const qualityOptions = Array.isArray(productData.qualities) ? productData.qualities : [];

      const pickFromOptions = (preferredValue, fallbackValue, optionsList) => {
        const normalizedOptions = Array.isArray(optionsList) ? optionsList.filter(Boolean) : [];
        const normalizedPreferred = String(preferredValue || "").trim();
        if (normalizedPreferred && normalizedOptions.includes(normalizedPreferred)) {
          return normalizedPreferred;
        }
        const normalizedFallback = String(fallbackValue || "").trim();
        if (normalizedFallback && normalizedOptions.includes(normalizedFallback)) {
          return normalizedFallback;
        }
        if (normalizedOptions.length) {
          return normalizedOptions[0];
        }
        return normalizedFallback || "";
      };

      const requestedMetal =
        (window.selectedOptions && window.selectedOptions.metal)
        || (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)).get("metal")
        || currentdefaults[0]
        || "";
      const defaultMetal = productData.default_metal || metalOptions[0] || "";
      const resolvedMetal = pickFromOptions(requestedMetal, defaultMetal, metalOptions);

      const requestedColor =
        (window.selectedOptions && window.selectedOptions.color)
        || (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)).get("color")
        || currentdefaults[1]
        || "";
      const defaultColor = productData.default_color || colorOptions[0] || "";
      const resolvedColor = pickFromOptions(requestedColor, defaultColor, colorOptions);

      const isL0Style = String(productData.style_number || "").startsWith("L0");
      const rawLevelOptions = Array.isArray(productData.levels) ? productData.levels : [];
      const levelOptions = rawLevelOptions;
      const fallbackLevel = isL0Style
        ? "Polished"
        : (productData.default_level || levelOptions[0] || "");
      const requestedLevel =
        (window.selectedOptions && window.selectedOptions.level)
        || (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)).get("level")
        || currentdefaults[2]
        || "";
      let resolvedLevel = pickFromOptions(requestedLevel, fallbackLevel, levelOptions);
      if (isL0Style && levelOptions.includes("Polished")) {
        resolvedLevel = "Polished";
      }

      const shouldSetQuality = !["Polished", "Clip & Ship"].includes(resolvedLevel);
      const requestedQuality =
        (window.selectedOptions && window.selectedOptions.quality)
        || (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)).get("quality")
        || currentdefaults[3]
        || "";
      const defaultQuality = productData.default_quality || qualityOptions[0] || "";
      const resolvedQuality = shouldSetQuality
        ? pickFromOptions(requestedQuality, defaultQuality, qualityOptions)
        : "";

      // Rebuild color options if colors array changed. Head mode owns the
      // swatch list (one style's colors would hide the sibling styles'
      // colors, e.g. Yellow disappearing after switching to a White style).
      if (
        productData.colors &&
        Array.isArray(productData.colors) &&
        !window.availableColorsOverride
      ) {
        rebuildColorOptions(productData.colors);
      }

      // Rebuild the diamond quality dropdown from the new style's qualities;
      // a product whose initial style had none loads with the control hidden
      // and its option list empty.
      if (typeof window.rebuildQualityOptions === "function") {
        window.rebuildQualityOptions(qualityOptions, resolvedQuality || defaultQuality);
      }

      const nextParams = {
        ...(resolvedMetal && !hasSStyleVariants ? { metal: resolvedMetal } : {}),
        ...(resolvedColor ? { color: resolvedColor } : {}),
        ...(resolvedLevel ? { level: resolvedLevel } : {}),
        quality: resolvedQuality,
      };
      if (resolvedMetal && !hasSStyleVariants) {
        currentdefaults[0] = resolvedMetal;
      }
      if (resolvedColor) {
        currentdefaults[1] = resolvedColor;
      }
      if (resolvedLevel) {
        currentdefaults[2] = resolvedLevel;
      }
      currentdefaults[3] = resolvedQuality;

      if (typeof window.batchUpdateQueryParams === "function") {
        window.batchUpdateQueryParams(nextParams);
        shouldFetchPrice = false;
      } else {
        window.suspendPriceUpdate = true;
        try {
          if (newMetal && typeof updateQueryParam === "function" && !hasSStyleVariants) {
            updateQueryParam("metal", newMetal);
          }
          if (newColor && typeof updateQueryParam === "function") {
            updateQueryParam("color", newColor);
          }
          if (resolvedLevel && typeof updateQueryParam === "function") {
            updateQueryParam("level", resolvedLevel);
          }
          if (typeof updateQueryParam === "function") {
            updateQueryParam("quality", shouldSetQuality ? newQuality : "");
          }
        } finally {
          window.suspendPriceUpdate = false;
        }
        if (typeof window.schedulePriceUpdate === "function") {
          window.schedulePriceUpdate();
          shouldFetchPrice = false;
        } else if (typeof window.fetchPriceDueDate === "function") {
          window.fetchPriceDueDate();
          shouldFetchPrice = false;
        }
      }
    }

    if (window.setLevelWeightData && productData) {
      const polished = productData.polish_weight ?? 0;
      const raw = productData.raw_casting_weight ?? 0;
      window.setLevelWeightData(Number(polished).toFixed(2), Number(raw).toFixed(2));
    }

    if (window.updateMeleeBreakdown && productData?.stone_breakdown) {
      window.updateMeleeBreakdown(productData.stone_breakdown);
    }

    if (typeof window.updateCenterStoneRequirements === "function") {
      const pegRequired = window.pegHeadRequired === true;
      const pegSelected = window.pegHeadSelected === true;
      const pegAllowsCenter = window.pegHeadAllowsCenter !== false;
      if (
        pegRequired &&
        pegSelected &&
        pegAllowsCenter &&
        Array.isArray(window.chosenpeg) &&
        window.chosenpeg[5] &&
        window.chosenpeg[6]
      ) {
        window.updateCenterStoneRequirements({
          stone_breakdown: [
            {
              center: true,
              shape: window.chosenpeg[5],
              dimension: window.chosenpeg[6],
              carat: "",
              setting: "Prong",
            },
          ],
          peg_head_setting: false,
        });
      } else {
        window.updateCenterStoneRequirements(productData);
      }
    }

    if (typeof window.updateMatchingStoneRequirements === "function") {
      window.updateMatchingStoneRequirements(productData);
    }

    if (typeof window.updateMatchingStoneStatus === "function") {
      const resolvedLevel = window.selectedOptions?.level || currentdefaults[2] || "";
      window.updateMatchingStoneStatus(resolvedLevel);
    }

    if (Array.isArray(productData?.inventory)) {
      window.stocked = productData.inventory;
      if (typeof window.renderStockPopup === "function") {
        window.renderStockPopup(productData.inventory);
      }
      if (typeof checkinstock === "function") {
        checkinstock();
      }
    }

    const variantSource = Array.isArray(productData?.product_variants) ? productData.product_variants : productVariants;
    const variantSizes = extractFingerSizesFromVariantStyles(variantSource);
    const variantNameSizes = extractFingerSizesFromVariantNames(variantSource);
    const combinedVariantSizes = Array.from(new Set([
      ...variantSizes,
      ...variantNameSizes,
    ])).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
    let nextFingerSizes = sizeOptionsForBase.length ? sizeOptionsForBase : combinedVariantSizes;
    if (!sizeOptionsForBase.length && parsedFingerSize && !nextFingerSizes.includes(parsedFingerSize)) {
      nextFingerSizes = Array.from(new Set([
        ...nextFingerSizes,
        parsedFingerSize,
      ])).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
    }
    window.fingerSizes = nextFingerSizes;
    if (typeof window.updateFingerSizeInput === "function") {
      const preferredFingerSize = hasFingerSize
        ? normalizeFingerSizeValue(productData?.finger_size || resolvedFingerSize)
        : "";
      if (preferredFingerSize) {
        currentdefaults[4] = preferredFingerSize;
        window.selectedOptions.finger_size = preferredFingerSize;
      }
      window.updateFingerSizeInput(nextFingerSizes, preferredFingerSize || resolvedFingerSize);
    }

    if (window.selectedOptions) {
      window.selectedOptions.variant = resolvedVariantValue;
    }
    if (typeof window.updateVariantUI === "function") {
      window.updateVariantUI(resolvedVariantValue);
    }

    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    params.set("variant", resolvedVariantValue);
    if (hasFingerSize && normalizedResolvedFingerSize) {
      params.set("finger_size", normalizedResolvedFingerSize);
    }
    const shouldUseVariantPath = Boolean(target?.url);
    const nextPathSource = productData?.url || target?.url;
    const nextPath = shouldUseVariantPath && nextPathSource
      ? `/product/${nextPathSource}`
      : window.location.pathname;
    // Keep existing finger_size parameter even if not applicable to this product
    window.history.replaceState({}, "", `${nextPath}?${params.toString()}`);
    if (shouldFetchPrice) {
      if (typeof window.schedulePriceUpdate === "function") {
        window.schedulePriceUpdate();
      } else if (typeof window.fetchPriceDueDate === "function") {
        window.fetchPriceDueDate();
      }
    }
  };

  const shouldApplyInitialVariant =
    normalizedQueryVariantParam && variants.includes(normalizedQueryVariantParam);
  window.deferInitialPriceFetch = Boolean(shouldApplyInitialVariant);
  if (shouldApplyInitialVariant) {
    const applyInitialVariant = () => {
      if (typeof window.applyVariantData === "function") {
        window.applyVariantData(normalizedQueryVariantParam);
      }
    };
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", applyInitialVariant, { once: true });
    } else {
      applyInitialVariant();
    }
  }

</script>

<script>
  //Function that sets structured data once and then deletes itself:
  function LDJSONimg() {
	let ldj = document.querySelector("#LDjson");
	let LDimglist = [];

	document.querySelectorAll(".images-review > img").forEach((entry) => {
		LDimglist.push('"' + entry.src + '"');
	});

	ldj.textContent = ldj.textContent.replace('"LDimgreplace"', '[' + LDimglist + ']');

	LDJSONimg = function(){};
  }
  //Function that sets structured data once and then deletes itself:
  function LDJSONprice(jprice) {
	let ldj = document.querySelector("#LDjson");
	
	ldj.textContent = ldj.textContent.split('"price": ')[0] + '"price": ' + jprice + ',\n\t\t"itemCondition"' + ldj.textContent.split('"itemCondition"')[1];
	
	LDJSONprice = function(){};
  }

  function formatNumber(value) {
    return Number(value).toLocaleString('en-US', {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    });
  }
  // loadding price display
  function startLoadingPrice() {
    const singlePriceEl = document.getElementById('single-price-value');
    const totalPriceEl = document.getElementById('total-price-value');
    singlePriceEl?.classList.add('loading');
    totalPriceEl?.classList.add('loading');
  }
  function stopLoadingPrice() {
    const singlePriceEl = document.getElementById('single-price-value');
    const totalPriceEl = document.getElementById('total-price-value');
    singlePriceEl?.classList.remove('loading');
    totalPriceEl?.classList.remove('loading');
  }
  async function fetchPriceDueDate(options) {
    startLoadingPrice();
    const requestState = window.__priceDueDateRequestState || {
      key: "",
      time: 0,
      inFlight: false,
    };
    try {
      const requestOptions = options && typeof options === "object" ? options : {};
      const quantityOverride = Number(requestOptions.quantity);
      const quantityFromControl = typeof window.getQuantityValue === "function"
        ? Number(window.getQuantityValue())
        : Number(document.querySelector("[data-quantity-input]")?.value || 1);
      const requestQuantity = Number.isFinite(quantityOverride) && quantityOverride > 0
        ? Math.floor(quantityOverride)
        : Number.isFinite(quantityFromControl) && quantityFromControl > 0
          ? Math.floor(quantityFromControl)
          : 1;
      const selections = window.selectedOptions || {};
      const liveParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const resolvedMetal = selections.metal || currentdefaults[0] || "";
      const resolvedColor = selections.color || queryColor || currentdefaults[1] || "";
      const resolvedLevel = selections.level || currentdefaults[2] || "";
      const resolvedQuality = liveParams.get("quality") || currentdefaults[3] || "";
      const resolvedStyleNumber = selections.style_number || "10002-10X8";
      const resolvedFingerSize = hasFingerSize
        ? normalizeFingerSizeValue(
            liveParams.get("finger_size") || selections.finger_size || currentdefaults[4] || ""
          )
        : "";
      const normalizedLevel = String(resolvedLevel || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      const isClipShip = normalizedLevel === "clip & ship";
      const engraving = selections.engraving ? selections.engraving.trim() : "";
      const engravingfont = selections.engravingfont ? selections.engravingfont.trim() : "";
      const centerInput = document.getElementById("chosencenter");
      const center2Input = document.getElementById("chosencenter2");
      const pegInput = document.getElementById("chosenpeghead");
      const setCenterCheckbox = document.querySelector("[name=setcenterstone]");
      const assemblePegCheckbox = document.getElementById("assemble-peghead-checkbox");
      const centerValue = (centerInput?.value || liveParams.get("center") || "").trim();
      const center2Value = (center2Input?.value || liveParams.get("center2") || "").trim();
      const pegValue = (pegInput?.value || liveParams.get("head") || "").trim();
      const includeCenter = Boolean(centerValue && (!setCenterCheckbox || setCenterCheckbox.checked));
      const includePeg = Boolean(pegValue && !isClipShip);
      const requestParams = {
        style_number: resolvedStyleNumber,
        color: resolvedColor,
        ...(hasFingerSize && resolvedFingerSize ? { finger_size: resolvedFingerSize } : {}),
        ...(engraving && engravingfont ? { engraving: engraving, engravingfont: engravingfont } : {}),
        ...(includeCenter ? { center: centerValue, center_diamond: centerValue } : {}),
        ...(center2Value ? { center2: center2Value, match_diamond: center2Value } : {}),
        ...(includePeg ? { head: pegValue } : {}),
        ...(includePeg && assemblePegCheckbox ? { assemblepeghead: assemblePegCheckbox.checked } : {}),
        quantity: requestQuantity,
        metal: resolvedMetal,
        level: resolvedLevel,
        quality: resolvedQuality,
        format: "json",
      };
      const requestKey = new URLSearchParams(requestParams).toString();
      const now = Date.now();
      if (
        (requestState.inFlight && requestState.key === requestKey) ||
        (requestState.key === requestKey && now - requestState.time < 300)
      ) {
        return;
      }
      requestState.key = requestKey;
      requestState.time = now;
      requestState.inFlight = true;
      window.__priceDueDateRequestState = requestState;

      const requestHeaders = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      };

      if (typeof isIframe != "undefined" && isIframe && customerId) {
        requestHeaders["X-Iframe-Customer-Id"] = customerId;
      }

      const response = await axios.get('/api/calculate-price-due-date/', {
        params: requestParams,
        headers: requestHeaders
      });

      const rawPrice = Number(response?.data?.price || 0);
      const normalizedQuantity = requestQuantity > 0 ? requestQuantity : 1;
      const perItemPrice = rawPrice / normalizedQuantity;
      const dueDate = response?.data?.due_date?.replace(/-/g, "/") || "";
	  
	  //Add the price to the merchant metadata:
	  if (rawPrice) {
		LDJSONprice(rawPrice);
	  }

      const estimatedDelivery = document.getElementById('estimated-delivery');
      const singlePriceValue = document.getElementById('single-price-value');
      const totalPriceValue = document.getElementById('total-price-value');

      const markup = Number(typeof custommarkup !== "undefined" ? custommarkup : 1) || 1;
      window.baseProductPrice = perItemPrice * markup;
      window.basePriceIncludesCenter = includeCenter;
      window.basePriceIncludesMatching = Boolean(center2Value);
      window.basePriceIncludesPegHead = includePeg;

      if (estimatedDelivery) {
        estimatedDelivery.innerHTML = dueDate;
      }
      //The visible price must come from window.baseProductPrice (which
      //carries custommarkup) rather than the raw fetch price. Signed-in
      //pages get re-rendered from
      //baseProductPrice anyway by total-price-display.js on the
      //product:price-updated event below, but anonymous pages have no
      //quantity control, so that script never initializes for them and this
      //write is the one they keep:
      const displayUnitPrice = formatNumber(window.baseProductPrice);
      if (singlePriceValue) {
        singlePriceValue.value = `$${displayUnitPrice}`;
      }
      if (totalPriceValue) {
        totalPriceValue.value = `$${displayUnitPrice}`;
      }
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("product:price-updated"));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error fetching Price and Due Date:", error);
    } finally {
      requestState.inFlight = false;
      window.__priceDueDateRequestState = requestState;
      stopLoadingPrice();
    }
  }
  
	function changetexts() {
		let changeelements = document.querySelectorAll(".popcartadd h2, .cartadder .status");
		let changeelements2 = document.querySelector("#cart-button > div");
		
		try {
			changeelements.forEach((entry) => {
				entry.textContent = "Updating Cart Item";
			});
		}
		catch {};
		
		try {
			changeelements2.textContent = "Update Cart Item";
		}
		catch {};
	}

  window.fetchPriceDueDate = fetchPriceDueDate;
  window.startLoadingPrice = startLoadingPrice;
  window.stopLoadingPrice = stopLoadingPrice;
  const shouldAutoFetchInitialPrice = !window.deferInitialPriceFetch;
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      () => {
        try {
          if (window.parent.location.pathname.startsWith("/editproduct")) {
            try { changetexts(); }
            catch {};
          }
        } catch (e) {}
		
        if (shouldAutoFetchInitialPrice) {
          fetchPriceDueDate();
        }
      },
      { once: true }
    );
  } else if (shouldAutoFetchInitialPrice) {
    fetchPriceDueDate();
  }
</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const weightParam = params.get("weight");

        if (weightParam && typeof window.selectWeight === "function") {
            window.selectWeight(weightParam);
        }


        const variant = params.get("variant");
        if (variant) {
            if (typeof window.selectDiameter === "function") {
                window.selectDiameter(variant);
            } else if (typeof window.updateVariantUI === "function") {
                window.updateVariantUI(variant);
            }
        }
    });
</script>
