<script>
    const fingerSizeControl = document.getElementById('finger-size-control');
    function applyFingerSizeVisibility() {
        if (!fingerSizeControl) {
            return;
        }
        const dimensionType = window.variantGridDimensionType || "";
        const showForMm = dimensionType === "mm" || dimensionType === "mm-only";
        const shouldHide = Boolean(window.variantGridActive) && !showForMm;
        fingerSizeControl.hidden = shouldHide;
        fingerSizeControl.classList.toggle("hidden", shouldHide);
    }

    window.applyFingerSizeVisibility = applyFingerSizeVisibility;
    applyFingerSizeVisibility();
    const fingerSizeInput = document.getElementById('finger-size-input');
    const fingerSizeUp = document.getElementById('finger-size-up');
    const fingerSizeDown = document.getElementById('finger-size-down');
    const fingerSizeDropdown = document.getElementById('finger-size-dropdown');
    const fingerSizeDropdownValue = document.getElementById('finger-size-value');
    const fingerSizeDropdownOptions = document.getElementById('finger-size-options');
    const fingerSizeDropdownHint = document.getElementById('finger-size-scroll-hint');
    const fingerSizeInputMode = document.getElementById('finger-size-input-mode');
    const fingerNumberSelect = document.getElementById('fingernumberopts');
    const initialFingerSize = window.initialFingerSize || "";
    const emptySelectionLabel = "Select your size";
    let lastRenderedSizeKey = "";
    let defaultFingerSize = "";
    const defaultFallbackSize = "7";
    const freeFingerSizeMin = 3;
    const freeFingerSizeMax = 15.75;
    const freeFingerSizeStep = 0.25;

    function normalizeFingerSizeValue(value) {
        const numericValue = parseFloat(value);
        if (Number.isNaN(numericValue)) {
            return "";
        }
        return numericValue.toFixed(2);
    }
    function displayFingerSize(value) {
        const numericValue = parseFloat(value);
        if (Number.isNaN(numericValue)) {
            return String(value || "");
        }
        if (Number.isInteger(numericValue)) {
            return numericValue.toString();
        }
        return numericValue.toFixed(2);
    }

    function normalizeFingerSizes(list) {
        if (!Array.isArray(list)) {
            return [];
        }
        return list
            .map((value) => normalizeFingerSizeValue(value))
            .filter((value) => value !== "")
            .sort((a, b) => parseFloat(a) - parseFloat(b));
    }

    // Digits after a style number's last "S" are only a finger size when they fall in
    // the range the store sells (3-13.5 in the catalog today; 2-16 leaves headroom).
    // Larger numbers are style identifiers that happen to follow an "S", e.g. the
    // "S18097" in "NS18097H-8MM".
    function isPlausibleFingerSize(value) {
        const numericValue = Number(value);
        if (Number.isNaN(numericValue)) {
            return false;
        }
        return numericValue >= 2 && numericValue <= 16;
    }

    // A style number is size-suffixed only when its last "S" token parses to a
    // plausible finger size.
    function styleNumberHasSizeSuffix(styleValue) {
        const normalized = String(styleValue || "");
        const lastIndex = normalized.lastIndexOf("S");
        if (lastIndex === -1) {
            return false;
        }
        const sizeMatch = normalized.slice(lastIndex + 1).match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
        return Boolean(sizeMatch) && isPlausibleFingerSize(sizeMatch[1]);
    }

    // F1619 through F1628 solitaires are sold online in finger size 7 only;
    // any other size must be ordered through Customer Service. Anchored so
    // longer base styles (e.g. a future F16195) never match; the character
    // after the base must be a non-digit separator or end of string.
    // Keep in sync with the copy in development_static/js/cartv2.js.
    const sizeLockedStylePattern = /^F16(19|2[0-8])(?:$|[^0-9])/;
    const sizeLockedFingerSize = "7.00";
    const baseProductStyleNumber = "10002\u002D10X8";

    function isFingerSizeLockedToSeven() {
        return sizeLockedStylePattern.test(baseProductStyleNumber.trim());
    }

    function showFingerSizeCustomerServicePrompt() {
        const promptHtml = 'This style is available online in finger size 7 only.<br>' +
            'To order a different finger size, please call Customer Service at ' +
            '<a class="underline" href="tel:+18887311111">(888) 731-1111</a>.';
        if (typeof sysalert === "function") {
            sysalert(promptHtml, "");
        } else {
            alert("This style is available online in finger size 7 only. To order a different finger size, please call Customer Service at (888) 731-1111.");
        }
    }

    // Returns true (and prompts the customer to call Customer Service) when a
    // size-locked product would be changed to any finger size other than 7.
    function blockLockedFingerSizeChange(requestedValue) {
        if (!isFingerSizeLockedToSeven()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (normalizeFingerSizeValue(requestedValue) === sizeLockedFingerSize) {
            return false;
        }
        showFingerSizeCustomerServicePrompt();
        return true;
    }

    const fingerSizeServiceNote = document.getElementById("finger-size-service-note");
    if (fingerSizeServiceNote && isFingerSizeLockedToSeven()) {
        fingerSizeServiceNote.hidden = false;
        fingerSizeServiceNote.classList.remove("hidden");
    }

    function updateCartButtonForFingerSize(isReady) {
        if (!hasFingerSize) {
            return;
        }
        const cartButton = document.getElementById("cart-button") || document.querySelector(".cartbtn");
        if (!cartButton) {
            return;
        }
        if (isReady) {
            if (cartButton.dataset.fingerSizeBlocked === "1") {
                delete cartButton.dataset.fingerSizeBlocked;
                cartButton.classList.remove("opacity-60", "cursor-not-allowed");
                cartButton.removeAttribute("title");
                cartButton.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "false");
            }
            return;
        }
        cartButton.dataset.fingerSizeBlocked = "1";
        cartButton.classList.add("opacity-60", "cursor-not-allowed");
        cartButton.setAttribute("title", "Select a finger size to add to cart.");
        cartButton.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
    }

    function syncFingerSizeDefaults(value) {
        const normalized = normalizeFingerSizeValue(value);
        if (!normalized) {
            return;
        }
        if (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined") {
            currentdefaults[4] = normalized;
        }
        if (window.selectedOptions) {
            window.selectedOptions.finger_size = normalized;
        }
    }

    function ensureFingerSizeDropdownHandler() {
        if (!fingerSizeDropdownOptions || fingerSizeDropdownOptions.dataset.bound === "true") {
            return;
        }
        fingerSizeDropdownOptions.dataset.bound = "true";
        fingerSizeDropdownOptions.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
            const option = event.target.closest(".property-option-item");
            if (!option) {
                return;
            }
            event.stopPropagation();
            const value = option.getAttribute("property-value") || option.textContent.trim();
            if (blockLockedFingerSizeChange(value)) {
                fingerSizeDropdown?.classList.remove("active");
                return;
            }
            window.deferFingerSizeSelection = false;
            if (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined") {
                currentdefaults[4] = value;
            }
            if (window.selectedOptions) {
                window.selectedOptions.finger_size = normalizeFingerSizeValue(value) || value;
            }
            if (fingerSizeDropdownValue) {
                fingerSizeDropdownValue.innerText = displayFingerSize(value);
            }
            if (fingerSizeInput) {
                fingerSizeInput.value = displayFingerSize(value);
            }
            updateCartButtonForFingerSize(true);
            Array.from(fingerSizeDropdownOptions.querySelectorAll(".property-option-item")).forEach((entry) => {
                const isActive = entry.getAttribute("property-value") === value;
                entry.querySelector(".finger-size-radio-active")?.classList.toggle("hidden", !isActive);
                entry.querySelector(".finger-size-radio-inactive")?.classList.toggle("hidden", isActive);
                entry.querySelector(".finger-size-check-icon")?.classList.toggle("hidden", !isActive);
                entry.classList.toggle("bg-gray-100", isActive);
            });
            updateQueryParam("finger_size", value);
            triggerVariantRefreshForSizeChange();
            fingerSizeDropdown?.classList.remove("active");
        });
    }

    async function triggerVariantRefreshForSizeChange() {
        if (typeof window.applyVariantData !== "function" || !window.selectedOptions?.variant) {
            return;
        }
        const styleValue = String(window.selectedOptions?.style_number || "").trim();
        const isSStyle = styleNumberHasSizeSuffix(styleValue);
        if (isSStyle) {
            window.suspendPriceUpdate = true;
        }
        try {
            await window.applyVariantData(window.selectedOptions.variant, { preserveSelections: true });
        } finally {
            if (isSStyle) {
                window.suspendPriceUpdate = false;
            }
        }
    }

    function isSStyleSelected() {
        const styleValue = String(window.selectedOptions?.style_number || "").trim();
        return styleNumberHasSizeSuffix(styleValue);
    }
    function markSuspendIfSStyle() {
        if (isSStyleSelected()) {
            window.suspendPriceUpdate = true;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function getSelectSizesFromExisting() {
        if (!fingerNumberSelect) {
            return [];
        }
        const options = Array.from(fingerNumberSelect.options || []);
        if (!options.length) {
            return [];
        }
        return options
            .map((option) => normalizeFingerSizeValue(option.value || option.textContent))
            .filter((value) => value !== "")
            .sort((a, b) => parseFloat(a) - parseFloat(b));
    }

    function getInventorySizesForSelection() {
        const selections = window.selectedOptions || {};
        const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const resolvedMetal = selections.metal || (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined" ? currentdefaults[0] : "");
        const resolvedColor = selections.color || (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined" ? currentdefaults[1] : "");
        const resolvedLevel = selections.level || (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined" ? currentdefaults[2] : "");
        const resolvedQuality = params.get("quality") || (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined" ? currentdefaults[3] : "");
        if (!Array.isArray(window.stocked) || window.stocked.length === 0) {
            return [];
        }
        const sizes = new Set();
        window.stocked.forEach((entry) => {
            if (!entry) {
                return;
            }
            if (resolvedMetal && entry.metal && entry.metal !== resolvedMetal) {
                return;
            }
            if (resolvedColor && entry.color && entry.color !== resolvedColor) {
                return;
            }
            if (resolvedLevel && entry.level && entry.level !== resolvedLevel) {
                return;
            }
            if (resolvedQuality && entry.quality && entry.quality !== resolvedQuality) {
                return;
            }
            const rawValue = entry.finger_size;
            if (!rawValue || ["None", "N/A"].includes(String(rawValue))) {
                return;
            }
            const normalized = normalizeFingerSizeValue(rawValue);
            if (normalized) {
                sizes.add(normalized);
            }
        });
        return Array.from(sizes).sort((a, b) => parseFloat(a) - parseFloat(b));
    }

    function getVariantBaseFromStyle(styleNumber) {
        const normalized = String(styleNumber || "");
        const lastIndex = normalized.lastIndexOf("S");
        if (lastIndex === -1) {
            return "";
        }
        return normalized.slice(0, lastIndex + 1);
    }

    function getVariantBaseForName(variantName) {
        if (!Array.isArray(window.productVariants)) {
            return "";
        }
        const normalized = String(variantName || "").trim();
        const match = window.productVariants.find((entry) => {
            return String(entry?.variant_name || "").trim() === normalized;
        });
        return getVariantBaseFromStyle(match?.style_number || "");
    }

    function getSizesForVariantBase(baseStyle) {
        if (!baseStyle || !Array.isArray(window.productVariants)) {
            return [];
        }
        const sizes = new Set();
        window.productVariants.forEach((entry) => {
            const styleNumber = String(entry?.style_number || "");
            if (!styleNumber.startsWith(baseStyle)) {
                return;
            }
            const lastIndex = styleNumber.lastIndexOf("S");
            if (lastIndex === -1) {
                return;
            }
            const after = styleNumber.slice(lastIndex + 1);
            const match = after.match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
            if (!match || !isPlausibleFingerSize(match[1])) {
                return;
            }
            const normalized = normalizeFingerSizeValue(match[1]);
            if (normalized) {
                sizes.add(normalized);
            }
        });
        return Array.from(sizes).sort((a, b) => parseFloat(a) - parseFloat(b));
    }

    function getFingerSizes() {
        const hasVariants = Array.isArray(window.productVariants) && window.productVariants.length > 0;
        if (!hasVariants) {
            return [];
        }
        if (Array.isArray(window.fingerSizes) && window.fingerSizes.length) {
            return window.fingerSizes;
        }
        return [];
    }

    function resolveFingerSizeValue(preferredValue) {
        // Size-locked styles always resolve to 7, regardless of URL
        // parameters, prior selections, or variant-derived size lists.
        if (isFingerSizeLockedToSeven()) {
            return sizeLockedFingerSize;
        }
        const sizes = getFingerSizes();
        const queryValue = normalizeFingerSizeValue(
            new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("finger_size")
        );
        const fallbackValue = preferredValue
            || (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined" && currentdefaults[4] ? String(currentdefaults[4]) : "");
        const normalizedFallback = normalizeFingerSizeValue(fallbackValue);
        const currentValue = normalizeFingerSizeValue(fingerSizeInput.value);

        if (sizes.length === 0) {
            return queryValue || normalizedFallback || currentValue || defaultFallbackSize;
        }
        if (queryValue && sizes.includes(queryValue)) {
            return queryValue;
        }
        if (normalizedFallback && sizes.includes(normalizedFallback)) {
            return normalizedFallback;
        }
        if (currentValue && sizes.includes(currentValue)) {
            return currentValue;
        }
        return sizes[0] || defaultFallbackSize;
    }

    function updateFingerSizeInput(sizes, preferredValue) {
        if (Array.isArray(sizes)) {
            window.fingerSizes = sizes;
        }
        let normalized = getFingerSizes();
        let usedExistingSelect = false;
        if (normalized.length === 0 && Array.isArray(window.productVariants)) {
            normalized = getSizesForVariantBase(getVariantBaseForName(window.selectedOptions?.variant || ""));
        }
        if (normalized.length === 0 && Array.isArray(window.productVariants)) {
            const firstBase = getVariantBaseForName(window.productVariants?.[0]?.variant_name || "");
            normalized = getSizesForVariantBase(firstBase);
        }
        if (normalized.length === 0 && typeof extractFingerSizesFromVariantStyles === "function") {
            normalized = extractFingerSizesFromVariantStyles(window.productVariants || []);
        }
        if (normalized.length === 0) {
            const selectSizes = getSelectSizesFromExisting();
            if (selectSizes.length) {
                normalized = selectSizes;
                usedExistingSelect = true;
            }
        }

        const shouldHideControl = !hasFingerSize && (!Array.isArray(normalized) || normalized.length === 0);
        if (fingerSizeControl) {
            fingerSizeControl.hidden = shouldHideControl;
            fingerSizeControl.classList.toggle("hidden", shouldHideControl);
        }
        if (shouldHideControl) {
            return;
        }
        const currentStyle = String(window.selectedOptions?.style_number || "").trim();
        const isSStyle = styleNumberHasSizeSuffix(currentStyle);
        const gridActive = Boolean(window.variantGridActive);
        const gridDimension = window.variantGridDimensionType || "";
        const hideForSizeGrid = !isSStyle && gridActive && gridDimension !== "mm" && gridDimension !== "mm-only";
        if (hideForSizeGrid && fingerSizeControl) {
            fingerSizeControl.hidden = true;
            fingerSizeControl.classList.add("hidden");
            return;
        }

        const shouldDeferSelection = Boolean(window.deferFingerSizeSelection);
        const preferredNormalized = normalizeFingerSizeValue(preferredValue);
        const inputNormalizedRaw = normalizeFingerSizeValue(fingerSizeInput?.value);
        const inputNormalized = shouldDeferSelection ? "" : inputNormalizedRaw;
        const hasExplicitSelection =
            (preferredNormalized && normalized.includes(preferredNormalized)) ||
            (inputNormalized && normalized.includes(inputNormalized));
        // Size-locked styles are always considered selected at size 7, so
        // deferred-selection placeholders never apply to them.
        defaultFingerSize = shouldDeferSelection && !hasExplicitSelection && !isFingerSizeLockedToSeven()
            ? ""
            : resolveFingerSizeValue(preferredValue);
        updateCartButtonForFingerSize(isFingerSizeLockedToSeven() || !shouldDeferSelection || hasExplicitSelection);

        const useDropdown = Array.isArray(normalized) && normalized.length > 0;

        if (fingerNumberSelect) {
            if (useDropdown && (!usedExistingSelect || !fingerNumberSelect.options.length)) {
                fingerNumberSelect.innerHTML = "";
                normalized.forEach((val) => {
                    const opt = document.createElement("option");
                    opt.value = String(val);
                    opt.textContent = String(val);
                    fingerNumberSelect.appendChild(opt);
                });
            }
            let preferred = "";
            if (!shouldDeferSelection || hasExplicitSelection) {
                preferred = preferredNormalized && normalized.includes(preferredNormalized) ? preferredNormalized : "";
                if (!preferred && inputNormalized && normalized.includes(inputNormalized)) {
                    preferred = inputNormalized;
                }
                if (!preferred) {
                    preferred = normalized[0] || defaultFallbackSize;
                }
            }
            if (shouldDeferSelection && !hasExplicitSelection) {
                if (!fingerNumberSelect.querySelector('option[value=""]')) {
                    const placeholder = document.createElement("option");
                    placeholder.value = "";
                    placeholder.textContent = emptySelectionLabel;
                    placeholder.disabled = true;
                    placeholder.hidden = true;
                    fingerNumberSelect.prepend(placeholder);
                }
                fingerNumberSelect.value = "";
            } else {
                fingerNumberSelect.value = preferred;
            }
            fingerNumberSelect.style.display = "none";
        }

        if (fingerSizeDropdown) {
            fingerSizeDropdown.hidden = !useDropdown;
            fingerSizeDropdown.classList.toggle("hidden", !useDropdown);
        }
        if (fingerSizeInputMode) {
            fingerSizeInputMode.hidden = useDropdown;
            fingerSizeInputMode.classList.toggle("hidden", useDropdown);
        }
        if (typeof window.toggleVariantDropdownForFreeInput === "function") {
            window.toggleVariantDropdownForFreeInput();
        }
        const isMmGrid = window.variantGridDimensionType === "mm" || window.variantGridDimensionType === "mm-only";
        if (useDropdown && isMmGrid) {
            const variantGrid = document.getElementById("variant-grid");
            const variantDropdown = document.getElementById("variant-dropdown");
            const variantHeading = document.getElementById("variant-heading");
            if (variantGrid) {
                variantGrid.classList.add("hidden");
                variantGrid.classList.remove("flex");
            }
            if (variantDropdown) {
                variantDropdown.classList.remove("hidden");
            }
            if (variantHeading) {
                variantHeading.classList.toggle("hidden", variantDropdown?.classList.contains("hidden"));
            }
            window.variantGridActive = false;
        }

        if (useDropdown && fingerSizeDropdownOptions && fingerSizeDropdownValue) {
            let selectedValue = "";
            if (isFingerSizeLockedToSeven()) {
                selectedValue = sizeLockedFingerSize;
            } else if (!shouldDeferSelection || hasExplicitSelection) {
                selectedValue = preferredNormalized && normalized.includes(preferredNormalized) ? preferredNormalized : "";
                if (!selectedValue && inputNormalized && normalized.includes(inputNormalized)) {
                    selectedValue = inputNormalized;
                }
                if (!selectedValue) {
                    selectedValue = normalized[0];
                }
            }
            const sizeKey = `${normalized.join(",")}|${selectedValue || ""}`;
            if (sizeKey !== lastRenderedSizeKey) {
                lastRenderedSizeKey = sizeKey;
                fingerSizeDropdownValue.innerText = selectedValue
                    ? displayFingerSize(selectedValue)
                    : emptySelectionLabel;
                syncFingerSizeDefaults(selectedValue);
                const optionHtml = normalized.map((size) => {
                    const isChosen = size === selectedValue && Boolean(selectedValue);
                    return `
                    <div class="self-stretch pl-2.5 pr-3 py-1 inline-flex justify-start items-center gap-2.5 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 property-option-item" property-type="finger_size" property-value="${size}">
                        <div class="flex-1 flex justify-between items-center">
                            <div class="flex-1 flex justify-start items-center gap-1">
                                <svg class="finger-size-radio-active ${isChosen ? "" : "hidden"}" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                    <path d="M18.8 12C18.8 8.24446 15.7555 5.2 12 5.2C8.24446 5.2 5.2 8.24446 5.2 12C5.2 15.7555 8.24446 18.8 12 18.8V20C7.58172 20 4 16.4183 4 12C4 7.58172 7.58172 4 12 4C16.4183 4 20 7.58172 20 12C20 16.4183 16.4183 20 12 20V18.8C15.7555 18.8 18.8 15.7555 18.8 12Z" fill="#727C8D" />
                                    <path d="M6.40039 11.9999C6.40039 15.0927 8.9076 17.5999 12.0004 17.5999C15.0932 17.5999 17.6004 15.0927 17.6004 11.9999C17.6004 8.90711 15.0932 6.3999 12.0004 6.3999C8.9076 6.3999 6.40039 8.90711 6.40039 11.9999Z" fill="#1D2940" />
                                </svg>
                                <svg class="finger-size-radio-inactive ${isChosen ? "hidden" : ""}" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                    <path d="M18.8 12C18.8 8.24446 15.7555 5.2 12 5.2C8.24446 5.2 5.2 8.24446 5.2 12C5.2 15.7555 8.24446 18.8 12 18.8V20C7.58172 20 4 16.4183 4 12C4 7.58172 7.58172 4 12 4C16.4183 4 20 7.58172 20 12C20 16.4183 16.4183 20 12 20V18.8C15.7555 18.8 18.8 15.7555 18.8 12Z" fill="#727C8D"/>
                                </svg>
                                <div class="justify-start text-slate-500 text-xs font-normal font-['Lato'] leading-5">${displayFingerSize(size)}</div>
                            </div>
                            <svg class="finger-size-check-icon ${isChosen ? "" : "hidden"}" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                <path d="M11.8138 4.81311C12.0092 4.61803 12.3263 4.61833 12.5214 4.81376C12.7165 5.00919 12.7162 5.32635 12.5208 5.52144L7.40685 11.2942C7.21156 11.4891 6.8956 11.4893 6.70047 11.2942L3.48042 8.07417C3.28516 7.87892 3.28518 7.56241 3.48042 7.36714C3.67568 7.17188 3.99219 7.17188 4.18745 7.36714L7.05333 10.233L11.8138 4.81311Z" fill="#727C8D" />
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
                }).join("");
                fingerSizeDropdownOptions.innerHTML = optionHtml;
                ensureFingerSizeDropdownHandler();
                if (fingerSizeDropdownHint) {
                    fingerSizeDropdownHint.classList.toggle("hidden", normalized.length <= 6);
                }
            } else {
                fingerSizeDropdownValue.innerText = selectedValue
                    ? displayFingerSize(selectedValue)
                    : emptySelectionLabel;
                syncFingerSizeDefaults(selectedValue);
            }
        }

        const numericSizes = normalized
            .map((value) => parseFloat(value))
            .filter((value) => !Number.isNaN(value));
        if (normalized.length === 0) {
            fingerSizeInput.min = freeFingerSizeMin.toString();
            fingerSizeInput.max = freeFingerSizeMax.toString();
            fingerSizeInput.step = freeFingerSizeStep.toString();
            let value = parseFloat(defaultFingerSize || defaultFallbackSize);
            if (Number.isNaN(value)) {
                value = freeFingerSizeMin;
            }
            value = Math.min(Math.max(value, freeFingerSizeMin), freeFingerSizeMax);
            value = Math.round(value / freeFingerSizeStep) * freeFingerSizeStep;
            fingerSizeInput.value = displayFingerSize(value.toFixed(2));
            syncFingerSizeDefaults(fingerSizeInput.value);
        } else {
            if (numericSizes.length > 0) {
                fingerSizeInput.min = Math.min(...numericSizes).toString();
                fingerSizeInput.max = Math.max(...numericSizes).toString();
            } else {
                fingerSizeInput.removeAttribute("min");
                fingerSizeInput.removeAttribute("max");
            }
            fingerSizeInput.removeAttribute("step");
            if (defaultFingerSize) {
                fingerSizeInput.value = displayFingerSize(defaultFingerSize);
                fingerSizeInput.removeAttribute("placeholder");
                syncFingerSizeDefaults(defaultFingerSize);
            } else {
                fingerSizeInput.value = "";
                fingerSizeInput.setAttribute("placeholder", emptySelectionLabel);
            }
        }
    }

    window.updateFingerSizeInput = updateFingerSizeInput;
    updateFingerSizeInput((typeof fingerSizes !== "undefined") ? fingerSizes : [], initialFingerSize);

    if (fingerNumberSelect) {
        fingerNumberSelect.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
            if (blockLockedFingerSizeChange(e.target.value)) {
                e.target.value = (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined" && currentdefaults[4]) || sizeLockedFingerSize;
                return;
            }
            window.deferFingerSizeSelection = false;
            const normalized = normalizeFingerSizeValue(e.target.value) || defaultFallbackSize;
            if (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined") {
                currentdefaults[4] = normalized;
            }
            if (window.selectedOptions) {
                window.selectedOptions.finger_size = normalized;
            }
            if (fingerSizeInput) {
                fingerSizeInput.value = displayFingerSize(normalized);
            }
            updateCartButtonForFingerSize(true);
            markSuspendIfSStyle();
            updateQueryParam("finger_size", normalized);
            triggerVariantRefreshForSizeChange();
        });
    }

    window.updateFingerSizeOptionsForVariant = (variantName) => {
        const baseStyle = getVariantBaseForName(variantName);
        const sizes = getSizesForVariantBase(baseStyle);
        if (sizes.length) {
            const preferred = window.deferFingerSizeSelection ? "" : sizes[0];
            updateFingerSizeInput(sizes, preferred);
        }
    };

    fingerSizeInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        if (blockLockedFingerSizeChange(e.target.value)) {
            e.target.value = displayFingerSize(
                (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined" && currentdefaults[4]) || sizeLockedFingerSize
            );
            return;
        }
        window.deferFingerSizeSelection = false;
        const sizes = getFingerSizes();
        const numericSizes = sizes
            .map((value) => parseFloat(value))
            .filter((value) => !Number.isNaN(value));
        let value = parseFloat(e.target.value);
        if (Number.isNaN(value)) {
            value = parseFloat(defaultFingerSize);
        }
        if (Number.isNaN(value)) {
            value = numericSizes.length ? numericSizes[0] : parseFloat(defaultFallbackSize);
        }
        if (numericSizes.length === 0) {
            value = Math.min(Math.max(value, freeFingerSizeMin), freeFingerSizeMax);
            value = Math.round(value / freeFingerSizeStep) * freeFingerSizeStep;
        } else if (numericSizes.length) {
            const minValue = Math.min(...numericSizes);
            const maxValue = Math.max(...numericSizes);
            if (value < minValue) {
                value = minValue;
            }
            if (value > maxValue) {
                value = maxValue;
            }
            value = numericSizes.reduce((closest, candidate) => {
                return Math.abs(candidate - value) < Math.abs(closest - value) ? candidate : closest;
            }, numericSizes[0]);
        }
        const normalizedValue = normalizeFingerSizeValue(value) || defaultFallbackSize;
        if (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined") {
            currentdefaults[4] = normalizedValue;
        }
        if (window.selectedOptions) {
            window.selectedOptions.finger_size = normalizedValue;
        }
        e.target.value = displayFingerSize(normalizedValue);
        updateCartButtonForFingerSize(true);
        markSuspendIfSStyle();
        updateQueryParam('finger_size', normalizedValue);
        triggerVariantRefreshForSizeChange();
    });

    fingerSizeUp.addEventListener('click', () => {
        // Any step away from the locked size 7 routes to Customer Service.
        if (isFingerSizeLockedToSeven()) {
            showFingerSizeCustomerServicePrompt();
            return;
        }
        window.deferFingerSizeSelection = false;
        const sizes = getFingerSizes();
        if (sizes.length === 0) {
            const currentValue = parseFloat(fingerSizeInput.value);
            const nextValue = Number.isNaN(currentValue) ? parseFloat(defaultFallbackSize) : currentValue + 0.25;
            let adjustedValue = nextValue;
            adjustedValue = Math.min(Math.max(adjustedValue, freeFingerSizeMin), freeFingerSizeMax);
            const normalizedValue = normalizeFingerSizeValue(adjustedValue) || defaultFallbackSize;
            if (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined") {
                currentdefaults[4] = normalizedValue;
            }
            if (window.selectedOptions) {
                window.selectedOptions.finger_size = normalizedValue;
            }
            fingerSizeInput.value = displayFingerSize(normalizedValue);
            updateCartButtonForFingerSize(true);
            markSuspendIfSStyle();
            updateQueryParam('finger_size', normalizedValue);
            triggerVariantRefreshForSizeChange();
            return;
        }
        let currentValue = normalizeFingerSizeValue(fingerSizeInput.value);
        if (!sizes.includes(currentValue)) {
            currentValue = defaultFingerSize;
        }
        if (!sizes.includes(currentValue)) {
            currentValue = sizes[0];
        }
        const currentIndex = sizes.indexOf(currentValue);
        if (currentIndex > -1 && currentIndex < sizes.length - 1) {
            const newValue = sizes[currentIndex + 1];
            if (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined") {
                currentdefaults[4] = newValue;
            }
            if (window.selectedOptions) {
                window.selectedOptions.finger_size = normalizeFingerSizeValue(newValue) || newValue;
            }
            fingerSizeInput.value = displayFingerSize(newValue);
            updateCartButtonForFingerSize(true);
            markSuspendIfSStyle();
            updateQueryParam('finger_size', newValue);
            triggerVariantRefreshForSizeChange();
        }
    });

    fingerSizeDown.addEventListener('click', () => {
        // Any step away from the locked size 7 routes to Customer Service.
        if (isFingerSizeLockedToSeven()) {
            showFingerSizeCustomerServicePrompt();
            return;
        }
        window.deferFingerSizeSelection = false;
        const sizes = getFingerSizes();
        if (sizes.length === 0) {
            const currentValue = parseFloat(fingerSizeInput.value);
            const nextValue = Number.isNaN(currentValue) ? parseFloat(defaultFallbackSize) : currentValue - 0.25;
            let adjustedValue = nextValue;
            adjustedValue = Math.min(Math.max(adjustedValue, freeFingerSizeMin), freeFingerSizeMax);
            const normalizedValue = normalizeFingerSizeValue(adjustedValue) || defaultFallbackSize;
            if (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined") {
                currentdefaults[4] = normalizedValue;
            }
            if (window.selectedOptions) {
                window.selectedOptions.finger_size = normalizedValue;
            }
            fingerSizeInput.value = displayFingerSize(normalizedValue);
            updateCartButtonForFingerSize(true);
            markSuspendIfSStyle();
            updateQueryParam('finger_size', normalizedValue);
            triggerVariantRefreshForSizeChange();
            return;
        }
        let currentValue = normalizeFingerSizeValue(fingerSizeInput.value);
        if (!sizes.includes(currentValue)) {
            currentValue = defaultFingerSize;
        }
        if (!sizes.includes(currentValue)) {
            currentValue = sizes[0];
        }
        const currentIndex = sizes.indexOf(currentValue);
        if (currentIndex > 0) {
            const newValue = sizes[currentIndex - 1];
            if (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined") {
                currentdefaults[4] = newValue;
            }
            if (window.selectedOptions) {
                window.selectedOptions.finger_size = normalizeFingerSizeValue(newValue) || newValue;
            }
            fingerSizeInput.value = displayFingerSize(newValue);
            updateCartButtonForFingerSize(true);
            markSuspendIfSStyle();
            updateQueryParam('finger_size', newValue);
            triggerVariantRefreshForSizeChange();
        }
    });
</script>

<!-- ===== JS (Collapse) ===== -->
<script>
  (function () {
    const toggles = document.querySelectorAll("[data-breakdown-toggle]");

    toggles.forEach((toggle) => {
      // Find nearest "card scope" then collapse inside it
      const scope = toggle.closest(".w-full") || toggle.parentElement;
      const collapse = scope?.querySelector("[data-breakdown-collapse]");
      const labels = toggle.querySelectorAll("[data-breakdown-label]");

      if (!collapse) return;

      // set initial height based on aria-expanded
      const isOpen = toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";
      if (!isOpen) collapse.style.maxHeight = "0px";

      const setOpen = (open) => {
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
        labels.forEach((lb) => (lb.textContent = open ? "Show less" : "Show more"));

        if (open) {
          collapse.style.maxHeight = collapse.scrollHeight + "px";
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true") {
              collapse.style.maxHeight = "9999px";
            }
          }, 240);
        } else {
          collapse.style.maxHeight = collapse.scrollHeight + "px";
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            collapse.style.maxHeight = "0px";
          });
        }
      };

      toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const openNow = toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";
        setOpen(!openNow);
      });
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  const stone_breakdown = JSON.parse(
    document.getElementById("stone-breakdown").textContent
  );
  window.initialStoneBreakdown = stone_breakdown;

  function updateMeleeBreakdown(stoneBreakdown) {
    const meleeStones = (stoneBreakdown || []).filter(stone => !stone.center);
    const hasMelee = meleeStones.length > 0;

    const levelParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("level");
    const selectedLevel =
      levelParam
      || (window.selectedOptions && window.selectedOptions.level)
      || (typeof currentdefaults !== "undefined" ? currentdefaults[2] : "");

    const normalizedLevel = (selectedLevel || "").trim();
    const isExcludedLevel = ["Clip & Ship", "Polished"].includes(normalizedLevel);
    const showMelee = ((hasMelee && !isExcludedLevel) || isL0Style);

    const total_stone_breakdown_carat = meleeStones
      .map(stone => (parseFloat(stone.carat) || 0) * (parseInt(stone.quantity, 10) || 0))
      .reduce((total, carat) => total + carat, 0);

    const total_quantity_stone_breakdown = meleeStones
      .map(stone => (parseInt(stone.quantity, 10) || 0))
      .reduce((total, quantity) => total + quantity, 0);

    const totalCaratEl = document.getElementById("total_stone_breakdown_carat");
    const totalQtyEl = document.getElementById("total_quantity_stone_breakdown");
    const statusEl = document.getElementById("melee-breakdown-status");
    const tbody = document.getElementById("melee-breakdown-body");

    if (totalCaratEl) {
      totalCaratEl.innerText = hasMelee ? total_stone_breakdown_carat.toFixed(3) : "0.000";
    }
    if (totalQtyEl) {
      totalQtyEl.innerText = hasMelee ? String(total_quantity_stone_breakdown) : "0";
    }

    if (statusEl) {
      const statusText = statusEl.querySelector("#melee-breakdown-text");
      const statusIcon = statusEl.querySelector("#melee-breakdown-icon");

      if (statusText) statusText.innerText = showMelee ? "Included" : "Not included";
      if (statusIcon) statusIcon.classList.toggle("hidden", showMelee);
    }

    if (tbody) {
      tbody.innerHTML = "";
      if (hasMelee) {
        meleeStones.forEach((stone) => {
          const row = document.createElement("tr");
          row.className = "border-t border-slate-100";

          const cut = document.createElement("td");
          cut.className = "py-2 pr-6";

          const cutWrap = document.createElement("div");
          cutWrap.className = "inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-bold leading-5";

          const cutImg = document.createElement("img");
          cutImg.className = "w-5 h-5";
          cutImg.alt = stone.shape || "Melee";
          cutImg.src = `/static/assets/icons/${stone.shape}.svg`;

          const cutName = document.createElement("span");
          cutName.textContent = stone.shape || "";

          // keep order like your original: img then text OR text then img (your choice)
          cutWrap.appendChild(cutImg);
          cutWrap.appendChild(cutName);
          cut.appendChild(cutWrap);

          const qty = document.createElement("td");
          qty.className = "py-2 pr-4 font-bold leading-5";
          qty.textContent = `x${stone.quantity ?? ""}`;

          const carat = document.createElement("td");
          carat.className = "py-2 pr-4 font-bold leading-5";
          carat.textContent = stone.carat || "";

          const size = document.createElement("td");
          size.className = "py-2 font-bold leading-5";
          size.textContent = (stone.dimension || "").replace(" mm", "");

          row.appendChild(cut);
          row.appendChild(qty);
          row.appendChild(carat);
          row.appendChild(size);

          tbody.appendChild(row);
        });
      }
    }

    // If you want: hide whole block when no melee
    // document.querySelectorAll("[data-breakdown-toggle], [data-breakdown-collapse]").forEach((node) => {
    //   node.classList.toggle("hidden", !showMelee);
    // });

    document.querySelectorAll("[data-breakdown-toggle], [data-breakdown-collapse]").forEach((node) => {
      node.classList.remove("hidden");
    });
  }

  window.updateMeleeBreakdown = updateMeleeBreakdown;
  updateMeleeBreakdown(stone_breakdown);
</script>

<script>
	let ceilinglab;
	let ceilingnatural;
    let bothamounts = 0;
    let stonesearch = "";
	
	//Unhide when this is all figured out:
	/*
	if (diashape == "Emerald,Radiant") {
		document.querySelector("#shapeopts").classList.remove("hidden");
	}
	*/

    function getActiveCenterRequirements() {
        const target = window.centerStoneSelectionTarget === "center2" ? "center2" : "center";
        if (target === "center2") {
            return {
                size: (typeof currentsize2 === "string" && currentsize2.trim()) ? currentsize2 : currentsize,
                shape: (window.matchingDiashape || diashape || "")
            };
        }
        return {
            size: currentsize,
            shape: diashape
        };
    }

    function buildStoneSearch() {
        // Recalculate stonesearch based on current variant's center stone size
        const requirements = getActiveCenterRequirements();
        if (typeof requirements.size === "string" && requirements.size.trim() && requirements.shape) {
            let currsizes = [
                Number(requirements.size.split(" ")[0]),
                Number(requirements.size.split(" ")[2]),
            ];

            if (!Number.isNaN(currsizes[0]) && !Number.isNaN(currsizes[1])) {
                stonesearch =
                    "?shape=" +
                    requirements.shape +
                    "&length=" +
                    (currsizes[0] - 0.15).toFixed(2) +
                    "-" +
                    (currsizes[0] + 0.15).toFixed(2) +
                    "&width=" +
                    (currsizes[1] - 0.15).toFixed(2) +
                    "-" +
                    (currsizes[1] + 0.15).toFixed(2) +
                    "&getamount=1";
                return stonesearch;
            }
        }
        stonesearch = "";
        return stonesearch;
    }

    // Build initial stonesearch
    buildStoneSearch();

</script>

<script>
    let lastStoneSearch = "";
    let centerCountRequest = null;

    function updateCenterStoneCounts() {
        if (!stonesearch) {
            const labLabel = document.querySelector("#center-stone-lab-type");
            const naturalLabel = document.querySelector("#center-stone-natural-type");
            if (labLabel) {
                labLabel.textContent = "...";
            }
            if (naturalLabel) {
                naturalLabel.textContent = "...";
            }
            return;
        }

        if (stonesearch === lastStoneSearch && centerCountRequest) {
            return;
        }
        lastStoneSearch = stonesearch;

        bothamounts = 0;
        // Use Promise.all for parallel API calls instead of sequential
        const fetchCounts = typeof window.getCenterStoneCounts === "function"
            ? window.getCenterStoneCounts
            : (search) => Promise.all([
                fetch("/api/diamonds/lab/" + search).then(r => r.json()),
                fetch("/api/diamonds/natural/" + search).then(r => r.json())
            ]).then(([labData, naturalData]) => {
                const labCount = Number(labData?.count?.filtered || 0);
				ceilinglab = labCount;
                const naturalCount = Number(naturalData?.count?.filtered || 0);
				ceilingnatural = naturalCount;
                return {
                    lab: labCount,
                    natural: naturalCount,
                    total: labCount + naturalCount,
                    search,
                };
            });

        centerCountRequest = fetchCounts(stonesearch)
            .then((result) => {
                if (!result) {
                    return;
                }
                const labCount = Number(result.lab || 0);
				ceilinglab = labCount;
                const naturalCount = Number(result.natural || 0);
				ceilingnatural = naturalCount;
                bothamounts = Number(result.total || (labCount + naturalCount));
                
                const labLabel = document.querySelector("#center-stone-lab-type");
                if (labLabel) {
                    labLabel.textContent = labCount.toLocaleString();
                }
                
                const naturalLabel = document.querySelector("#center-stone-natural-type");
                if (naturalLabel) {
                    naturalLabel.textContent = naturalCount.toLocaleString();
                }

                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("centerstone:count-updated", {
                    detail: {
                        total: bothamounts,
                        lab: labCount,
                        natural: naturalCount,
                        search: result.search || stonesearch,
                    }
                }));
            })
            .catch(error => console.error('Error fetching center stone counts:', error))
            .finally(() => {
                centerCountRequest = null;
            });
    }

    window.updateCenterStoneSearch = function updateCenterStoneSearch(nextSearch) {
        stonesearch = String(nextSearch || "");
        updateCenterStoneCounts();
    };

    // Function to refresh stone search when variant changes
    window.refreshCenterStoneConstraints = function refreshCenterStoneConstraints() {
        buildStoneSearch();
        updateCenterStoneCounts();
        
        // If the diamond listing dialog is open, refresh it with new constraints
        if (typeof showDiamondListing === "function") {
            showDiamondListing(currentType);
        }
    };

    updateCenterStoneCounts();

</script>

<!-- render show auto select -->
<script>
    function renterShowAutoSelect(data) {
        const info = [
            data.image_url,
            data.shape,
            data.carat,
            data.clarity,
            data.lot_number,
            data.length + " x " + data.width + " mm",
        ];
		
		let login;
		
		//If not showing the login prompt, add the dollar sign:
		if (login) { data.price = (Number(data.price) * custommarkupD).toLocaleString("en-US", {style:"currency", currency:"USD"}); }
		else { data.price = '<a href="/account/login?next=' + encodeURIComponent(location.pathname + location.search) + '" class="underline hovfocopac">Log in</a>'; }

        let vidor360 = (data.video_url || data.vision360_url);

        let labornat;
        if (data.is_lab) {
            labornat = " (Lab Grown)";
        } else {
            labornat = " (Natural)";
        }

        let girdle = data.girdle
            .toProperCase()
            .replace(" To ", "–")
            .replace("ium", "")
            .replace("Slightly Thick", "Stk")
            .replace("Sl. Thick", "Stk")
            .replace("Sl.Thick", "Stk")
            .replace("Very Thick", "Vtk")
            .replaceAll("Thick", "Thk")
            .replace("tra", ".")
            .replace("tremely", ".");



        let reformatsettingtype = "";
        if (settingtype == "Channel" || settingtype == "Bezel") {
            reformatsettingtype = "bezel_channel";
        } else {
            if (settingtype !== "Prong") {
                reformatsettingtype = "other";
            }
            reformatsettingtype = (
                reformatsettingtype || settingtype
            ).toLowerCase();
        }

        let certword = "Certificate";
		let labcode = data.lab;
		if (labcode == "GIA") {
			certword = "Report";
			labcode = `<img width="56" height="16" src="/static/img/icons/bbgia.svg" alt="GIA - Gemological Institute of America">`;
		}
		else if (labcode == "IGI") {
			labcode = `<img width="48" height="16" src="/static/img/icons/bbigi.svg" alt="IGI - International Gemological Institute">`;
		}

        let certfront = data.certificate_number;
        if (!certfront) {
            certfront = "View " + certword;
        }

        // show diamond property interface
        // type: string | svg | link
        // label: string
        // value: string
        // link: string (for link type)
        // box: 1 | 2

        // ----------------------

        const showDiamondProperty = [
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Shape",
                value: data.shape,
                box: 1
            },
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Table %",
                value: `${data.table_percent}%`,
                box: 1
            },
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Carat",
                value: data.carat,
                box: 1
            },
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Girdle",
                value: girdle,
                box: 1
            },
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Clarity",
                value: data.clarity,
                box: 1
            },
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Culet",
                value: data.culet.toProperCase().replace("Ponted", "Pointed"),
                box: 1
            },
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Size (mm)",
                value: `${data.length} x ${data.width} x ${data.depth}`,
                box: 2
            },
            {
                type: "svg",
                label: "Lab",
                value: labcode,
                box: 2
            },
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Color",
                value: data.color,
                box: 2
            },
            {
                type: "link",
                label: "Certificate",
                link: data.certificate_url ? data.certificate_url : '#',
                value: certfront,
                box: 2
            },
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Polish",
                value: data.polish,
                box: 2
            },
            {
                type: "link",
                label: "Video",
                link: vidor360,
                value: vidor360 ? 'View Video' : 'No Video',
                box: 2
            },
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Symmetry",
                value: data.symmetry,
                box: 2
            },
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Price",
                value: data.price,
                box: 2
            },
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Fluorescence",
                value: data.fluorescence,
                box: 2
            },
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Setting Cost",
                value: Number(
                    data[reformatsettingtype + "_setting_charge"]
                ).toLocaleString("en-US", {
                    style: "currency",
                    currency: "USD",
                }),
                box: 2
            },
            {
                type: "string",
                label: "Depth %",
                value: `${data.depth_percent}%`,
                box: 2
            },

        ]

        const centerStoneProperty = document.getElementById('center-stone-auto-select-property');
        centerStoneProperty.innerHTML = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < showDiamondProperty.length; i++) {
            item = showDiamondProperty[i];
            let value = 'None'
            if (item.type === 'string' || (item.type === 'link' && !Boolean(item.link))) {
                value = `
                            <span class="w-[60%] text-right justify-start text-slate-800 text-sm font-bold font-['Lato'] leading-5
                            whitespace-nowrap">
                                ${item.value}
                            </span>
                        `
            } else if (item.type === 'link' && item.link) {
                value = `
                                <a href='${item.link}' target='_blank' class="w-[60%] text-right justify-start text-slate-800 
                                text-sm font-bold font-['Lato'] leading-5 underline">
                                    ${item.value}
                                </a>
                              `
            } else if (item.type === 'svg') {
                value = `
                       <div class="w-[60%] text-right justify-end flex">
                            ${item.value}
                       </div>
                      `
            }

            centerStoneProperty.innerHTML += `
                        <div 
                        class="w-full pb-2 border-b-[0.50px] border-slate-500/30  mb-2
                        inline-flex justify-start items-center gap-1
                        ${i % 2 === 0 ? 'mr-6' : 'ml-6'}"
                        >
                            <span class="w-20 justify-start text-slate-500 text-sm font-normal font-['Lato'] leading-5">
                                ${item.label}:
                            </span>
                            ${value}
                        </div>
                              `
        }

        document.getElementById("auto-select-stone-lot-number").innerText = data.lot_number;

        const centerStone = document.getElementById('auto-select-stone-preview-img');
        centerStone.src = (`${data.image_url}` || `/static/assets/icons/${data.shape}.svg`);
        centerStone.onerror = "this.src=`/static/img/nostone.jpg`; this.removeAttribute('onerror');";
    }
</script>

<script>
    
    const showAutoSelectStone = async (type) => {
            const reviewStep = document.getElementById("center-stone-dialog-review-auto-select-step");
            const categoryStep = document.getElementById("center-stone-dialog-select-category-step");
            type = type || window.centerStoneAutoSelectType;
            if (!type) return;
            
            window.centerStoneAutoSelectType = type;
            // Show the auto-select review step immediately so users see progress.
            if (reviewStep && categoryStep) {
                reviewStep.classList.remove("hidden");
                reviewStep.classList.add("flex");
                categoryStep.classList.remove("flex");
                categoryStep.classList.add("hidden");
            }

            try {
                const params = new URLSearchParams(
                    (typeof stonesearch === "string" && stonesearch.trim())
                        ? stonesearch.replace(/^\?/, "")
                        : (window.parent.location.search || "")
                );
				
				console.log(type);
				
				//Pick a random page based on the count for this type of diamond:
				let whichone = Math.floor(Math.random() * eval("ceiling" + type)) + 1;
				
				console.log(whichone);
                params.delete("getamount");
                params.set("limit", "1");
                params.set("page", whichone);
                params.set("format", "json");

                // IMPORTANT: use the real JSON endpoint path here
                const url = `/api/diamonds/${type}/?${params.toString()}`;

                const response = await fetch(url, {
                    headers: { "Accept": "application/json" },
                });

                const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";

                if (!response.ok) {
                    sysalert(`Request failed (${response.status})`, "bad");
                    // If fetch fails, return to category step so user can retry.
                    if (reviewStep && categoryStep) {
                        reviewStep.classList.add("hidden");
                        reviewStep.classList.remove("flex");
                        categoryStep.classList.remove("hidden");
                        categoryStep.classList.add("flex");
                    }
                    return;
                }

                // If server returned HTML, you'll catch it here before JSON parsing
                if (!contentType.includes("application/json")) {
                    const text = await response.text();
                    console.error("Expected JSON but got:", contentType, text.slice(0, 200));
                    sysalert("Server did not return JSON (wrong endpoint or redirect).", "bad");
                    if (reviewStep && categoryStep) {
                        reviewStep.classList.add("hidden");
                        reviewStep.classList.remove("flex");
                        categoryStep.classList.remove("hidden");
                        categoryStep.classList.add("flex");
                    }
                    return;
                }

                const json = await response.json();

                const data = json.diamonds?.[0];
                if (!data) {
                    sysalert("No diamond returned for auto select.", "bad");
                    if (reviewStep && categoryStep) {
                        reviewStep.classList.add("hidden");
                        reviewStep.classList.remove("flex");
                        categoryStep.classList.remove("hidden");
                        categoryStep.classList.add("flex");
                    }
                    return;
                }

                renterShowAutoSelect(data);
            } catch (err) {
                sysalert("Error on automatic diamond selection.", "bad");
                console.error(err);
                if (reviewStep && categoryStep) {
                    reviewStep.classList.add("hidden");
                    reviewStep.classList.remove("flex");
                    categoryStep.classList.remove("hidden");
                    categoryStep.classList.add("flex");
                }
            }
    }
    document.querySelectorAll(".center-stone-auto-select").forEach((button) => {
        button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
            const type = button.getAttribute('data-value');
            if(typeof window.showAutoSelectStone === "function") {
                window.showAutoSelectStoneLoading();
            }
            showAutoSelectStone(type).finally(() => {
                if(typeof window.hideAutoSelectStoneLoading === "function") {
                    window.hideAutoSelectStoneLoading();
                }
            });
        });
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.center-stone-listing-select').forEach((button) => {
        button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            const type = button.getAttribute('data-value');

            document.getElementById("center-stone-dialog-diamond-listing-step").classList.remove("hidden");
            document.getElementById("center-stone-dialog-select-category-step").classList.remove("flex");
            document.getElementById("center-stone-dialog-diamond-listing-step").classList.add("flex");
            document.getElementById("center-stone-dialog-select-category-step").classList.add("hidden");

            showDiamondListing(type);

        });
    });
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        window.showAutoSelectStone = showAutoSelectStone;
    });
</script>
