        /* ============================================================================
           SECTION 3: UTILITY FUNCTIONS
           ============================================================================
           Generic helpers for parsing, formatting, and DOM manipulation
           ============================================================================ */

        function parseNumberValue(value) {
            if (value === null || value === undefined) {
                return null;
            }
            const trimmedValue = String(value).trim();
            if (!trimmedValue) {
                return null;
            }
            const numberValue = Number(trimmedValue);
            return Number.isFinite(numberValue) ? numberValue : null;
        }

        function withSliderSync(callback) {
            diamondSliderState.syncing = true;
            callback();
            diamondSliderState.syncing = false;
        }

        function formatRangeInput(filterKey, value) {
            if (value === null || value === undefined || Number.isNaN(value)) {
                return '';
            }
            const numeric = Number(value);
            if (filterKey === 'cost') {
                return Math.round(numeric).toString();
            }
            return numeric.toFixed(2);
        }

        function formatDiscreteRangeLabel(minLabel, maxLabel) {
            if (minLabel === maxLabel) {
                return minLabel;
            }
            return `${minLabel} - ${maxLabel}`;
        }

        function parseRangeParam(paramValue) {
            if (!paramValue) {
                return null;
            }
            const parts = paramValue.split('-');
            if (parts.length !== 2) {
                return null;
            }
            const minValue = parseNumberValue(parts[0]);
            const maxValue = parseNumberValue(parts[1]);
            if (minValue === null || maxValue === null) {
                return null;
            }
            return { min: minValue, max: maxValue };
        }

        function getBaseSearchParams() {
            const base = new URLSearchParams(
                (typeof stonesearch === "string" && stonesearch.trim())
                    ? stonesearch.replace(/^\?/, "")
                    : (window.location.search || "")
            );
            base.delete('center');
            base.delete('getamount');
            return base;
        }

        function normalizeDiamondType(type) {
            return type === 'lab' ? 'lab' : 'natural';
        }

        function getStoredDiamondType() {
            try {
                const stored = sessionStorage.getItem(diamondTypeStorageKey);
                if (!stored) {
                    return null;
                }
                return normalizeDiamondType(stored);
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        function setStoredDiamondType(type) {
            try {
                sessionStorage.setItem(diamondTypeStorageKey, type);
            } catch (error) {
                // Ignore storage failures (private mode, etc).
            }
        }

        function updateDiamondTypeUI(type) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.diamond-type-button').forEach((button) => {
                const isActive = button.getAttribute('data-type') === type;
                button.classList.toggle('is-active', isActive);
                button.setAttribute('aria-selected', isActive ? 'true' : 'false');
            });
            const title = document.getElementById('center-stone-dialog-title');
            if (title) {
                const rawTitle = (title.textContent || '').trim();
                const baseTitle = rawTitle.includes(' - ')
                    ? rawTitle.split(' - ').slice(0, -1).join(' - ').trim()
                    : rawTitle;
                const typeLabel = type === 'lab' ? 'Lab Grown Diamonds' : 'Natural Mined Diamonds';
                title.textContent = `${typeLabel} ${'Selection'}`;
            }
        }

        function setDiamondType(type, options = {}) {
            const normalized = normalizeDiamondType(type);
            if (currentType === normalized && !options.force) {
                updateDiamondTypeUI(normalized);
                return;
            }
            setStoredDiamondType(normalized);
            updateDiamondTypeUI(normalized);
            if (!options.skipFetch) {
                showDiamondListing(normalized);
            } else {
                currentType = normalized;
            }
        }

        function setListingBusy(isBusy) {
            const table = document.getElementById('center-stone-listing-table');
            const pagination = document.getElementById('diamond-pagination');
            if (table) {
                table.setAttribute('aria-busy', isBusy ? 'true' : 'false');
            }
            if (pagination) {
                pagination.style.pointerEvents = isBusy ? 'none' : 'auto';
                pagination.style.opacity = isBusy ? '0.6' : '1';
            }
        }

        function setListingState(state, options = {}) {
            const root = document.getElementById('diamond-listing-state');
            if (!root) {
                return;
            }
            const title = document.getElementById('diamond-listing-state-title');
            const message = document.getElementById('diamond-listing-state-message');
            const loadingIcon = document.getElementById('diamond-listing-state-loading');
            const emptyIcon = document.getElementById('diamond-listing-state-empty-icon');
            const errorIcon = document.getElementById('diamond-listing-state-error-icon');
            const actionButton = document.getElementById('diamond-listing-state-action');

            const defaults = {
                loading: {
                    title: 'Loading diamonds...',
                    message: 'This may take a moment.'
                },
                empty: {
                    title: 'No in-stock options are currently available for this product.',
                    message: 'Please try adjusting the size or finish level, or check back later for availability.'
                },
                error: {
                    title: 'We could not load diamonds.',
                    message: 'Please check your connection and try again.'
                }
            };
            const content = { ...(defaults[state] || {}), ...options };

            if (title) {
                title.textContent = content.title || '';
            }
            if (message) {
                message.textContent = content.message || '';
                message.classList.toggle('hidden', !content.message);
            }

            if (loadingIcon) {
                loadingIcon.classList.toggle('hidden', state !== 'loading');
            }
            if (emptyIcon) {
                emptyIcon.classList.toggle('hidden', state !== 'empty');
            }
            if (errorIcon) {
                errorIcon.classList.toggle('hidden', state !== 'error');
            }

            if (actionButton) {
                if (state === 'empty') {
                    actionButton.textContent = 'Reset filters';
                    actionButton.classList.remove('hidden');
                    actionButton.onclick = () => resetAllFilters();
                } else if (state === 'error') {
                    actionButton.textContent = 'Try again';
                    actionButton.classList.remove('hidden');
                    actionButton.onclick = () => showDiamondListing(currentType);
                } else {
                    actionButton.classList.add('hidden');
                    actionButton.onclick = null;
                }
            }

            root.classList.toggle('hidden', state === 'ready');
            root.classList.toggle('is-loading', state === 'loading');
        }

        function renderSkeletonRows(count = 6) {
            const tableBody = document.querySelector('#center-stone-listing-table tbody');
            if (!tableBody) {
                return;
            }
            const rows = Array.from({ length: count }, () => `
            <tr class="diamond-skeleton-row">
                <td><div class="diamond-skeleton-block icon"></div></td>
                <td><div class="diamond-skeleton-block medium"></div></td>
                <td><div class="diamond-skeleton-block short"></div></td>
                <td><div class="diamond-skeleton-block long"></div></td>
                <td><div class="diamond-skeleton-block short"></div></td>
                <td><div class="diamond-skeleton-block short"></div></td>
                <td><div class="diamond-skeleton-block short"></div></td>
                <td><div class="diamond-skeleton-block medium"></div></td>
                <td><div class="diamond-skeleton-block short"></div></td>
            </tr>
        `).join('');
            tableBody.innerHTML = rows;
        }

        /* ============================================================================
           SECTION 4: API & SEARCH PARAMS
           ============================================================================
           Building search parameters and API queries
           ============================================================================ */

        function pruneFilterSet(filterKey, allowedValues) {
            const setRef = diamondFilterState[filterKey];
            if (!setRef) {
                return;
            }
            for (const value of Array.from(setRef)) {
                if (!allowedValues.includes(value)) {
                    setRef.delete(value);
                }
            }
        }

        function setParamsFromSet(params, key, values) {
            if (values.size) {
                params.set(key, Array.from(values).join(','));
            } else {
                params.delete(key);
            }
        }

        function setParamsFromRange(params, key, range) {
            if (!range) {
                params.delete(key);
                return;
            }
            const defaults = diamondRangeDefaults[key];
            if (defaults && range.min === defaults.min && range.max === defaults.max) {
                params.delete(key);
                return;
            }
            params.set(key, `${range.min}-${range.max}`);
        }

        function buildDiamondSearchParams() {
			/*let shapestring = "";
			document.querySelectorAll(".diamond-filter-shape.is-selected").forEach((entry) => { shapestring += entry.value + ","; });*/
			
            const params = getBaseSearchParams();
            //const baseShape = shapestring || params.get('shape');
            const baseLength = params.get('length');
            const baseWidth = params.get('width');

            //if (!baseShape) {
                setParamsFromSet(params, 'shape', diamondFilterState.shape);
            //}
			
			/*if (document.querySelector("#center-stone-dialog-select-category-step #shapeopts:not(.hidden)")) {
				baseShape = document.querySelector("#shapeopts > select").value;
			}*/

            setParamsFromSet(params, 'color', diamondFilterState.color);
            setParamsFromSet(params, 'clarity', diamondFilterState.clarity);
            setParamsFromSet(params, 'cut', diamondFilterState.cut);
            setParamsFromSet(params, 'fluorescence', diamondFilterState.fluorescence);

            if (currentType === 'lab') {
                setParamsFromSet(params, 'lab', diamondFilterState.lab);
            } else {
                params.delete('lab');
            }

            setParamsFromRange(params, 'carat', diamondFilterState.carat);
            if (isDiamondPriceEnabled) {
                setParamsFromRange(params, 'cost', diamondFilterState.cost);
            } else {
                params.delete('cost');
            }
            // Preserve base constraint parameters for length/width - only override if user has changed them
            if (diamondFilterState.length) {
                setParamsFromRange(params, 'length', diamondFilterState.length);
            } else if (!baseLength) {
                params.delete('length');
            }
            // Don't delete baseLength if it exists and diamondFilterState.length is null

            if (diamondFilterState.width) {
                setParamsFromRange(params, 'width', diamondFilterState.width);
            } else if (!baseWidth) {
                params.delete('width');
            }
            // Don't delete baseWidth if it exists and diamondFilterState.width is null

            setParamsFromRange(params, 'ratio', diamondFilterState.ratio);

            if (diamondFilterState.lot_number) {
                params.set('lot_number', diamondFilterState.lot_number);
            } else {
                params.delete('lot_number');
            }

            if (diamondFilterState.sort_by) {
                params.set('sort_by', diamondFilterState.sort_by);
            } else {
                params.delete('sort_by');
            }

            return params;
        }

        /* ============================================================================
           SECTION 5: FILTER RENDERING
           ============================================================================
           Creating and updating UI elements for filters
           ============================================================================ */

        function refreshDiamondListing() {
            page = 1;
            showDiamondListing(currentType);
            renderFilterChips();
        }

        function setButtonState(button, isSelected) {
            if (!button) {
                return;
            }
            if (isSelected) {
                button.classList.add('is-selected');
                button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
            } else {
                button.classList.remove('is-selected');
                button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
            }
        }

        function toggleFilterSetValue(filterKey, value, button) {
            const setRef = diamondFilterState[filterKey];
            if (!setRef || !value) {
                return;
            }
            if (button && button.classList.contains('is-locked')) {
                return;
            }
            const isSelected = setRef.has(value);
            if (isSelected) {
                setRef.delete(value);
            } else {
                setRef.add(value);
            }
            setButtonState(button, !isSelected);
            refreshDiamondListing();
        }

        function clearFilterSet(filterKey, container) {
            const setRef = diamondFilterState[filterKey];
            if (!setRef) {
                return;
            }
            setRef.clear();
            if (container) {
                container.querySelectorAll('.is-selected').forEach((button) => {
                    setButtonState(button, false);
                });
            }
        }

        function normalizeRangeValue(filterKey, value) {
            if (filterKey === 'cost') {
                return Math.round(Number(value));
            }
            return Number(Number(value).toFixed(2));
        }

        function updateRangeDefaultsFromResponse(data) {
            if (!data) {
                return;
            }
            const ranges = {
                carat: data?.carat?.unfiltered,
                length: data?.length?.unfiltered,
                width: data?.width?.unfiltered,
                cost: data?.cost?.unfiltered
            };
            Object.entries(ranges).forEach(([key, value]) => {
                if (!value) {
                    return;
                }
                const minValue = parseNumberValue(value.min);
                const maxValue = parseNumberValue(value.max);
                if (minValue === null || maxValue === null) {
                    return;
                }
                if (minValue === 0 && maxValue === 0) {
                    return;
                }
                diamondRangeDefaults[key] = { min: minValue, max: maxValue };
            });
        }

        function buildRangeOptions(filterKey, minValue, maxValue) {
            const range = {
                min: [minValue],
                max: [maxValue]
            };
            const breaks = diamondRangeBreaks[filterKey];
            if (!breaks) {
                return range;
            }
            breaks.forEach((entry) => {
                if (entry.value > minValue && entry.value < maxValue) {
                    range[entry.pos] = [entry.value];
                }
            });
            return range;
        }

        function getRangeStart(filterKey) {
            const defaults = diamondRangeDefaults[filterKey] || { min: 0, max: 0 };
            if (!diamondFilterState[filterKey]) {
                return [defaults.min, defaults.max];
            }
            const minValue = diamondFilterState[filterKey].min ?? defaults.min;
            const maxValue = diamondFilterState[filterKey].max ?? defaults.max;
            const clampedMin = Math.max(defaults.min, minValue);
            const clampedMax = Math.min(defaults.max, maxValue);
            return [clampedMin, clampedMax];
        }

        function setRangeFilterState(filterKey, minValue, maxValue) {
            const defaults = diamondRangeDefaults[filterKey] || { min: 0, max: 0 };
            let normalizedMin = normalizeRangeValue(filterKey, Math.min(minValue, maxValue));
            let normalizedMax = normalizeRangeValue(filterKey, Math.max(minValue, maxValue));

            // For length and width, clamp values within constraint bounds if constraints exist
            if ((filterKey === 'length' || filterKey === 'width') && diamondFilterState[filterKey]) {
                const constraint = diamondFilterState[filterKey];
                normalizedMin = Math.max(normalizedMin, constraint.min);
                normalizedMax = Math.min(normalizedMax, constraint.max);
            }

            const defaultMin = normalizeRangeValue(filterKey, defaults.min);
            const defaultMax = normalizeRangeValue(filterKey, defaults.max);

            // Check if values are at constraint bounds (not default bounds)
            let atConstraint = false;
            if ((filterKey === 'length' || filterKey === 'width') && diamondFilterState[filterKey]) {
                const constraint = diamondFilterState[filterKey];
                if (normalizedMin === constraint.min && normalizedMax === constraint.max) {
                    atConstraint = true;
                }
            }

            if (normalizedMin === defaultMin && normalizedMax === defaultMax && !atConstraint) {
                diamondFilterState[filterKey] = null;
            } else {
                diamondFilterState[filterKey] = { min: normalizedMin, max: normalizedMax };
            }
        }

        /* ============================================================================
           SECTION 6: SLIDER MANAGEMENT
           ============================================================================
           Creating, updating, and syncing range sliders with user interactions
           ============================================================================ */

        function syncRangeInputs(filterKey, minValue, maxValue) {
            const minInput = document.getElementById(`diamond-${filterKey}-min`);
            const maxInput = document.getElementById(`diamond-${filterKey}-max`);
            if (minInput) {
                minInput.value = formatRangeInput(filterKey, minValue);
            }
            if (maxInput) {
                maxInput.value = formatRangeInput(filterKey, maxValue);
            }
        }

        function createOrUpdateRangeSlider(filterKey) {
            if (filterKey === 'cost' && !isDiamondPriceEnabled) {
                return;
            }
            const slider = document.getElementById(`diamond-slider-${filterKey}`);
            if (!slider) {
                return;
            }
            // Use constraint values for length/width if available, otherwise use defaults.
            const defaults = ((filterKey === 'length' || filterKey === 'width') && diamondFilterState[filterKey])
                ? { min: diamondFilterState[filterKey].min, max: diamondFilterState[filterKey].max }
                : (diamondRangeDefaults[filterKey] || { min: 0, max: 0 });
            const minValue = defaults.min;
            const maxValue = defaults.max;
            const range = buildRangeOptions(filterKey, minValue, maxValue);
            const start = getRangeStart(filterKey);

            if (slider.noUiSlider) {
                withSliderSync(() => {
                    slider.noUiSlider.updateOptions({ range, start });
                });
                syncRangeInputs(filterKey, start[0], start[1]);
                return;
            }

            noUiSlider.create(slider, {
                start,
                connect: true,
                behaviour: 'tap-drag',
                range
            });

            slider.noUiSlider.on('update', (values) => {
                const minValue = parseNumberValue(values[0]) ?? defaults.min;
                const maxValue = parseNumberValue(values[1]) ?? defaults.max;
                syncRangeInputs(filterKey, minValue, maxValue);
            });

            slider.noUiSlider.on('set', (values) => {
                if (diamondSliderState.syncing) {
                    return;
                }
                const minValue = parseNumberValue(values[0]) ?? defaults.min;
                const maxValue = parseNumberValue(values[1]) ?? defaults.max;
                setRangeFilterState(filterKey, minValue, maxValue);
                refreshDiamondListing();
            });
        }

        function handleRangeInputChange(filterKey) {
            const defaults = diamondRangeDefaults[filterKey] || { min: 0, max: 0 };
            const minInput = document.getElementById(`diamond-${filterKey}-min`);
            const maxInput = document.getElementById(`diamond-${filterKey}-max`);
            const minValue = parseNumberValue(minInput?.value);
            const maxValue = parseNumberValue(maxInput?.value);
            const finalMin = minValue !== null ? minValue : defaults.min;
            const finalMax = maxValue !== null ? maxValue : defaults.max;
            const normalizedMin = Math.min(finalMin, finalMax);
            const normalizedMax = Math.max(finalMin, finalMax);

            const slider = document.getElementById(`diamond-slider-${filterKey}`);
            if (slider?.noUiSlider) {
                withSliderSync(() => {
                    slider.noUiSlider.set([normalizedMin, normalizedMax]);
                });
            }
            setRangeFilterState(filterKey, normalizedMin, normalizedMax);
            syncRangeInputs(filterKey, normalizedMin, normalizedMax);
            refreshDiamondListing();
        }

        function resetRangeFilter(filterKey) {
            const defaults = diamondRangeDefaults[filterKey] || { min: 0, max: 0 };

            // For length and width, don't clear constraint values - only reset user selections
            const constraint = diamondFilterState[filterKey];
            const hasConstraint = constraint && (constraint.min !== defaults.min || constraint.max !== defaults.max);

            if (hasConstraint && (filterKey === 'length' || filterKey === 'width')) {
                // Keep the constraint, just restore it to the slider
                const slider = document.getElementById(`diamond-slider-${filterKey}`);
                if (slider?.noUiSlider) {
                    withSliderSync(() => {
                        slider.noUiSlider.set([constraint.min, constraint.max]);
                    });
                }
                syncRangeInputs(filterKey, constraint.min, constraint.max);
            } else {
                // For other ranges or no constraints, reset to defaults
                diamondFilterState[filterKey] = null;
                const slider = document.getElementById(`diamond-slider-${filterKey}`);
                if (slider?.noUiSlider) {
                    withSliderSync(() => {
                        slider.noUiSlider.set([defaults.min, defaults.max]);
                    });
                }
                syncRangeInputs(filterKey, defaults.min, defaults.max);
            }
        }

        function renderSliderLabels(containerId, values) {
            const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
            if (!container) {
                return;
            }
            container.innerHTML = '';
            container.style.setProperty('--label-count', values.length || 1);
            values.forEach((value) => {
                const label = document.createElement('span');
                label.textContent = value;
                container.appendChild(label);
            });
        }

        function getDiscreteValuesForFilter(filterKey) {
            const current = diamondFilterLists[currentType] || diamondFilterLists.natural;
            if (filterKey === 'color') {
                return current.color || [];
            }
            if (filterKey === 'cut') {
                return current.cut || [];
            }
            if (filterKey === 'clarity') {
                return current.clarity || [];
            }
            if (filterKey === 'fluorescence') {
                return current.fluorescence || [];
            }
            return [];
        }

        function getDiscreteRangeFromState(filterKey, values) {
            const setRef = diamondFilterState[filterKey];
            if (!setRef || !setRef.size) {
                return [0, Math.max(values.length - 1, 0)];
            }
            const indices = values.map((value, index) => (setRef.has(value) ? index : null)).filter((value) => value !== null);
            if (!indices.length) {
                return [0, Math.max(values.length - 1, 0)];
            }
            return [Math.min(...indices), Math.max(...indices)];
        }

        function setDiscreteFilterRange(filterKey, values, minIndex, maxIndex) {
            const setRef = diamondFilterState[filterKey];
            if (!setRef) {
                return;
            }
            setRef.clear();
            for (let i = minIndex; i <= maxIndex; i += 1) {
                if (values[i]) {
                    setRef.add(values[i]);
                }
            }
        }

        function createOrUpdateDiscreteSlider(filterKey, options, labelsId) {
            const sliderId = filterKey === 'color' ? 'diamond-slider-color' : `diamond-slider-${filterKey}`;
            const slider = document.getElementById(sliderId);
            if (!slider || !options.length) {
                return;
            }
            const totalSegments = Math.max(options.length, 1);
            slider.__segmentCount = totalSegments;
            slider.classList.add('is-discrete');
            slider.style.setProperty('--segment-count', totalSegments);
            const [minIndex, maxSelectedIndex] = getDiscreteRangeFromState(filterKey, options);
            const sliderStart = [minIndex + 1, maxSelectedIndex + 2];
            const sliderRange = { min: 1, max: options.length + 1 };
            const sliderMargin = 1;

            if (slider.noUiSlider) {
                withSliderSync(() => {
                    slider.noUiSlider.updateOptions({
                        range: sliderRange,
                        start: sliderStart,
                        step: 1,
                        margin: sliderMargin,
                    });
                });
                updateDiscreteSeparatorCount(slider);
            } else {
                noUiSlider.create(slider, {
                    start: sliderStart,
                    step: 1,
                    connect: true,
                    behaviour: 'tap-drag',
                    margin: sliderMargin,
                    range: sliderRange,
                });

                slider.noUiSlider.on('update', (values) => {
                    if (diamondSliderState.syncing) {
                        return;
                    }
                    updateDiscreteSeparatorCount(slider);
                });

                slider.noUiSlider.on('set', (values) => {
                    if (diamondSliderState.syncing) {
                        return;
                    }
                    const minIndex = Math.max(0, Math.round(values[0]) - 1);
                    const maxIndex = Math.min(options.length - 1, Math.round(values[1]) - 2);
                    if (minIndex === 0 && maxIndex === options.length - 1) {
                        diamondFilterState[filterKey].clear();
                    } else {
                        setDiscreteFilterRange(filterKey, options, minIndex, maxIndex);
                    }
                    refreshDiamondListing();
                });
                updateDiscreteSeparatorCount(slider);
            }

            renderSliderLabels(labelsId, options);
        }

        function updateDiscreteSeparatorCount(slider) {
            const totalSegments = slider.__segmentCount || 1;
            const sliderWidth = slider.clientWidth;
            if (!sliderWidth) {
                return;
            }
            const segmentWidth = sliderWidth / totalSegments;
            slider.style.setProperty('--segment-count', totalSegments);
            slider.style.setProperty('--segment-width', `${segmentWidth}px`);
            const connect = slider.querySelector('.noUi-connect');
            if (!connect) {
                return;
            }
            connect.style.setProperty('--segment-count', totalSegments);
            connect.style.setProperty('--segment-width', `${segmentWidth}px`);
        }

        function syncDiscreteSliderFromState(filterKey, values) {
            const sliderId = filterKey === 'color' ? 'diamond-slider-color' : `diamond-slider-${filterKey}`;
            const slider = document.getElementById(sliderId);
            if (!slider?.noUiSlider || !values.length) {
                return;
            }
            const [minIndex, maxIndex] = getDiscreteRangeFromState(filterKey, values);
            const range = [minIndex + 1, maxIndex + 2];
            withSliderSync(() => {
                slider.noUiSlider.set(range);
            });
        }

        function renderFancyColorOptions() {
            const container = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-fancy-colors');
            if (!container) {
                return;
            }
            container.innerHTML = '';
            const options = ['Fancy', ...diamondFancyColorOptions];
            options.forEach((value) => {
                const button = document.createElement('button');
                button.type = 'button';
                button.className = 'diamond-filter-button';
                button.textContent = value === 'Fancy' ? 'All Fancy' : value;
                button.setAttribute('data-value', value);
                setButtonState(button, diamondFilterState.color.has(value));
                button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    if (value === 'Fancy') {
                        const shouldSelect = !diamondFilterState.color.has('Fancy');
                        diamondFilterState.color.clear();
                        if (shouldSelect) {
                            diamondFilterState.color.add('Fancy');
                        }
                        renderFancyColorOptions();
                        refreshDiamondListing();
                        return;
                    }
                    if (diamondFilterState.color.has('Fancy')) {
                        diamondFilterState.color.delete('Fancy');
                    }
                    toggleFilterSetValue('color', value, button);
                });
                container.appendChild(button);
            });
        }

        /* ============================================================================
           SECTION 7: COLOR MODE & FILTER RENDERING
           ============================================================================
           Rendering color options (standard/fancy) and lab options
           ============================================================================ */

        function renderLabOptions() {
            const container = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-lab');
            if (!container) {
                return;
            }
            container.innerHTML = '';
            const hasAvailabilityData = diamondAvailableLabs instanceof Set;

            diamondLabDisplayOptions.forEach((lab) => {
                const button = document.createElement('button');
                button.type = 'button';
                button.className = 'diamond-filter-button';
                button.setAttribute('data-value', lab.value);

                const icon = document.createElement('img');
                icon.src = lab.icon;
                icon.alt = lab.label;
                icon.className = 'diamond-filter-icon';

                const label = document.createElement('span');
                label.textContent = lab.label;

                button.appendChild(icon);
                button.appendChild(label);
                const isSelected = diamondFilterState.lab.has(lab.value);
                const isAvailable = !hasAvailabilityData || diamondAvailableLabs.has(lab.value);
                const isDisabled = !isAvailable && !isSelected;
                setButtonState(button, isSelected);
                button.classList.toggle('is-disabled', isDisabled);
                button.disabled = isDisabled;
                button.setAttribute('aria-disabled', isDisabled ? 'true' : 'false');

                button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    toggleFilterSetValue('lab', lab.value, button);
                    renderLabOptions();
                });

                container.appendChild(button);
            });
        }

        function buildLabAvailabilityParams() {
            const params = buildDiamondSearchParams();
            params.delete('lab');
            params.delete('page');
            params.delete('limit');
            params.delete('format');
            params.set('get_amount', '1');
            return params;
        }

        async function updateLabAvailability(type = currentType) {
            if (type !== 'lab') {
                diamondAvailableLabs = null;
                return;
            }
            const requestId = ++labAvailabilityRequestId;
            const baseParams = buildLabAvailabilityParams();
            const labChecks = diamondLabDisplayOptions.map(async (lab) => {
                const params = new URLSearchParams(baseParams.toString());
                params.set('lab', lab.value);
                try {
                    const response = await fetch(`/api/diamonds/${type}/?${params.toString()}`);
                    const data = await response.json();
                    return { lab: lab.value, count: data?.count?.filtered ?? 0 };
                } catch (error) {
                    return { lab: lab.value, count: 0 };
                }
            });
            const results = await Promise.all(labChecks);
            if (requestId !== labAvailabilityRequestId || type !== currentType) {
                return;
            }
            diamondAvailableLabs = new Set(
                results.filter((entry) => entry.count > 0).map((entry) => entry.lab)
            );
            renderLabOptions();
        }

        function setColorMode(mode, options = {}) {
            const forceUpdate = options.force === true;
            if (diamondColorMode === mode && !forceUpdate) {
                return;
            }
            diamondColorMode = mode;
            const standardPanel = document.getElementById('diamond-color-standard');
            const fancyPanel = document.getElementById('diamond-color-fancy');
            if (standardPanel && fancyPanel) {
                const isStandard = mode === 'standard';
                standardPanel.classList.toggle('hidden', !isStandard);
                fancyPanel.classList.toggle('hidden', isStandard);
                standardPanel.hidden = !isStandard;
                fancyPanel.hidden = isStandard;
                standardPanel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', isStandard ? 'false' : 'true');
                fancyPanel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', isStandard ? 'true' : 'false');
            }
            document.querySelectorAll('.diamond-color-tab').forEach((tab) => {
                tab.classList.toggle('is-active', tab.getAttribute('data-color-mode') === mode);
            });

            if (options.reset !== false) {
                diamondFilterState.color.clear();
                renderFancyColorOptions();
                const values = getDiscreteValuesForFilter('color');
                syncDiscreteSliderFromState('color', values);
                renderFilterChips();
                if (!options.skipRefresh) {
                    refreshDiamondListing();
                }
            }
        }

        function setDiamondFilterPanelVisibility(isVisible) {
            const filterPanel = document.getElementById('diamond-filters-panel');
            const toggleButton = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-toggle');
            if (!filterPanel || !toggleButton) {
                return;
            }
            filterPanel.classList.toggle('hidden', !isVisible);
            const label = toggleButton.querySelector('span');
            if (label) {
                label.textContent = isVisible ? 'Hide Filter' : 'Show Filter';
            }
            toggleButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isVisible ? 'true' : 'false');
        }

        function getLockedShapeSet(baseParams = getBaseSearchParams()) {
            return new Set(
                (baseParams.get('shape') || '')
                    .split(',')
                    .map((value) => value.trim())
                    .filter(Boolean)
            );
        }

        function renderShapeButtons() {
            const container = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-shapes');
            if (!container) {
                return;
            }
            //container.classList.toggle('max-h-32', !showAllShapes);
            container.classList.toggle('overflow-y-auto', !showAllShapes);
            container.innerHTML = '';
            const lockedShapes = getLockedShapeSet(getBaseSearchParams());
            let shapesToShow = showAllShapes ? [...diamondShapeOptions] : [...diamondShapeOptions.slice(0, 12)];
            if (!showAllShapes && lockedShapes.size) {
                const shapeValuesShown = new Set(shapesToShow.map((shape) => shape.value));
                diamondShapeOptions.forEach((shape) => {
                    if (lockedShapes.has(shape.value) && !shapeValuesShown.has(shape.value)) {
                        shapesToShow.push(shape);
                        shapeValuesShown.add(shape.value);
                    }
                });
            }
            for (const shape of shapesToShow) {
                const button = document.createElement('button');
                button.type = 'button';
                button.className = 'diamond-filter-shape';
                button.setAttribute('data-value', shape.value);
                const icon = document.createElement('img');
                icon.src = `/static/assets/icons/${shape.icon}`;
                icon.alt = shape.label;
                icon.className = 'w-6 h-6';
                const label = document.createElement('span');
                label.textContent = shape.label;
                button.appendChild(icon);
                button.appendChild(label);
                if (diamondFilterState.shape && diamondFilterState.shape.has(shape.value)) {
                    button.classList.add('is-selected');
                    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
                } else {
                    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
                }
                button.addEventListener('click', () => toggleFilterSetValue('shape', shape.value, button));
                container.appendChild(button);
            }

            // Update show all button text
            const showAllBtn = document.getElementById('diamond-show-all-shapes');
            if (showAllBtn) {
                showAllBtn.textContent = showAllShapes ? 'Show Less Shapes' : 'Show All Shapes';
            }
            syncLockedShapeFilter(getBaseSearchParams());
        }

        function syncLockedShapeFilter(baseParams) {
            const lockedShapes = getLockedShapeSet(baseParams);
            const shapesContainer = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-shapes');
            if (!shapesContainer) {
                return;
            }
            const shapeButtons = shapesContainer.querySelectorAll('.diamond-filter-shape');

            /* Lock certain shapes if specified in base parameters */
            if (lockedShapes.size) {
                diamondFilterState.shape.clear();
                shapeButtons.forEach((button) => {
                    const value = button.getAttribute('data-value');
                    if (lockedShapes.has(value)) {
                        diamondFilterState.shape.add(value);
                        button.classList.add('is-selected');
                        button.classList.remove('is-locked');
                        button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
                        button.inert = false;
                        button.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'false');
                    } else {
                        button.classList.remove('is-selected');
                        button.classList.add('is-locked');
                        button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
                        button.inert = true;
                        button.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
                    }
                });
                return;
            }
            shapeButtons.forEach((button) => {
                button.classList.remove('is-locked');
                button.inert = false;
                button.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'false');
            });
        }

        function syncFilterOptionsForType(type) {
            const current = diamondFilterLists[type] || diamondFilterLists.natural;
            const allowedColors = [...current.color, ...diamondFancyColorOptions, 'Fancy'];
            pruneFilterSet('color', allowedColors);
            pruneFilterSet('clarity', current.clarity);
            pruneFilterSet('cut', current.cut);
            pruneFilterSet('fluorescence', current.fluorescence);
            pruneFilterSet('lab', [...diamondLabOptions, 'Other']);

            const colorValues = current.color || [];
            createOrUpdateDiscreteSlider('color', colorValues, 'diamond-color-labels');
            createOrUpdateDiscreteSlider('cut', current.cut || [], 'diamond-cut-labels');
            createOrUpdateDiscreteSlider('clarity', current.clarity || [], 'diamond-clarity-labels');
            createOrUpdateDiscreteSlider('fluorescence', current.fluorescence || [], 'diamond-fluorescence-labels');

            renderFancyColorOptions();
            renderLabOptions();

            const labSection = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-lab-section');
            if (labSection) {
                if (type === 'lab') {
                    labSection.classList.remove('hidden');
                    labSection.inert = false;
                    labSection.removeAttribute('inert');
                } else {
                    // For natural diamonds: hide lab filter
                    labSection.classList.add('hidden');
                    labSection.inert = true;
                    labSection.setAttribute('inert', '');
                    diamondFilterState.lab.clear();
                }
            }
        }

        function renderFilterChips() {
            const chips = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-chips');
            if (!chips) {
                return;
            }
            chips.innerHTML = '';

            const baseParams = getBaseSearchParams();
            const lockedShapes = new Set((baseParams.get('shape') || '')
                .split(',')
                .map((value) => value.trim())
                .filter(Boolean));
            const lockedLength = parseRangeParam(baseParams.get('length'));
            const lockedWidth = parseRangeParam(baseParams.get('width'));

            const addChip = (label, filterKey, value) => {
                const chip = document.createElement('div');
                chip.className = 'diamond-filter-chip';
                const text = document.createElement('span');
                text.textContent = label;
                const button = document.createElement('button');
                button.type = 'button';
                button.textContent = 'x';
                button.addEventListener('click', () => removeFilterChip(filterKey, value));
                chip.appendChild(text);
                chip.appendChild(button);
                chips.appendChild(chip);
            };

            const addLockedChip = (label) => {
                const chip = document.createElement('div');
                chip.className = 'diamond-filter-chip diamond-filter-chip--locked';
                const text = document.createElement('span');
                text.textContent = label;
                chip.appendChild(text);
                chips.appendChild(chip);
            };

            if (lockedShapes.size) {
                addLockedChip(`Locked Shape: ${Array.from(lockedShapes).join(', ')}`);
            }
            if (lockedLength) {
                addLockedChip(`Locked Length: ${lockedLength.min}-${lockedLength.max}`);
            }
            if (lockedWidth) {
                addLockedChip(`Locked Width: ${lockedWidth.min}-${lockedWidth.max}`);
            }

            diamondFilterState.shape.forEach((shape) => {
                if (!lockedShapes.has(shape)) {
                    addChip(`Shape: ${shape}`, 'shape', shape);
                }
            });

            if (diamondFilterState.color.has('Fancy')) {
                addChip('Color: Fancy', 'color');
            } else if (diamondFilterState.color.size) {
                if (diamondColorMode === 'standard') {
                    const colorValues = getDiscreteValuesForFilter('color');
                    const indices = colorValues
                        .map((value, index) => (diamondFilterState.color.has(value) ? index : null))
                        .filter((value) => value !== null);
                    const hasAllColors = colorValues.length && colorValues.every((color) => diamondFilterState.color.has(color));
                    if (indices.length && !hasAllColors) {
                        const minLabel = colorValues[Math.min(...indices)];
                        const maxLabel = colorValues[Math.max(...indices)];
                        addChip(`Color: ${formatDiscreteRangeLabel(minLabel, maxLabel)}`, 'color');
                    }
                } else {
                    addChip(`Color: ${Array.from(diamondFilterState.color).join(', ')}`, 'color');
                }
            }

            const cutValues = getDiscreteValuesForFilter('cut');
            const clarityValues = getDiscreteValuesForFilter('clarity');
            const fluorescenceValues = getDiscreteValuesForFilter('fluorescence');

            if (diamondFilterState.cut.size && !(cutValues.length && cutValues.every((cut) => diamondFilterState.cut.has(cut)))) {
                const indices = cutValues
                    .map((value, index) => (diamondFilterState.cut.has(value) ? index : null))
                    .filter((value) => value !== null);
                if (indices.length) {
                    addChip(`Cut: ${formatDiscreteRangeLabel(cutValues[Math.min(...indices)], cutValues[Math.max(...indices)])}`, 'cut');
                }
            }
            if (diamondFilterState.clarity.size && !(clarityValues.length && clarityValues.every((clarity) => diamondFilterState.clarity.has(clarity)))) {
                const indices = clarityValues
                    .map((value, index) => (diamondFilterState.clarity.has(value) ? index : null))
                    .filter((value) => value !== null);
                if (indices.length) {
                    addChip(`Clarity: ${formatDiscreteRangeLabel(clarityValues[Math.min(...indices)], clarityValues[Math.max(...indices)])}`, 'clarity');
                }
            }
            if (diamondFilterState.fluorescence.size &&
                !(fluorescenceValues.length && fluorescenceValues.every((value) => diamondFilterState.fluorescence.has(value)))) {
                const indices = fluorescenceValues
                    .map((value, index) => (diamondFilterState.fluorescence.has(value) ? index : null))
                    .filter((value) => value !== null);
                if (indices.length) {
                    addChip(`Fluorescence: ${formatDiscreteRangeLabel(fluorescenceValues[Math.min(...indices)], fluorescenceValues[Math.max(...indices)])}`, 'fluorescence');
                }
            }

            if (diamondFilterState.lab.size) {
                addChip(`Lab: ${Array.from(diamondFilterState.lab).join(', ')}`, 'lab');
            }

            if (diamondFilterState.lot_number) {
                addChip(`Lot: ${diamondFilterState.lot_number}`, 'lot_number');
            }

            const rangeLabels = {
                carat: 'Carat',
                cost: 'Price',
                length: 'Length',
                width: 'Width',
                ratio: 'Ratio'
            };
            const lockedRanges = { length: lockedLength, width: lockedWidth };

            ['carat', 'cost', 'length', 'width', 'ratio'].forEach((rangeKey) => {
                if (rangeKey === 'cost' && !isDiamondPriceEnabled) {
                    return;
                }
                const rangeValue = diamondFilterState[rangeKey];
                if (!rangeValue) {
                    return;
                }
                const defaults = diamondRangeDefaults[rangeKey];
                if (defaults && rangeValue.min === defaults.min && rangeValue.max === defaults.max) {
                    return;
                }
                const lockedRange = lockedRanges[rangeKey];
                if (lockedRange && rangeValue.min === lockedRange.min && rangeValue.max === lockedRange.max) {
                    return;
                }
                addChip(`${rangeLabels[rangeKey]}: ${rangeValue.min}-${rangeValue.max}`, rangeKey);
            });

            updateFilterCount();
        }

        function updateFilterCount() {
            const count = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-count');
            if (!count) {
                return;
            }
            const chipCount = document.querySelectorAll('.diamond-filter-chip/*:not(.diamond-filter-chip--locked)*/').length;
            count.textContent = String(chipCount);
        }

        function removeFilterChip(filterKey, value) {
            if (['shape', 'color', 'clarity', 'cut', 'fluorescence', 'lab'].includes(filterKey)) {
                const setRef = diamondFilterState[filterKey];
                if (value) {
                    setRef.delete(value);
                } else {
                    setRef.clear();
                }

                if (filterKey === 'color') {
                    renderFancyColorOptions();
                    syncDiscreteSliderFromState('color', getDiscreteValuesForFilter('color'));
                } else if (['clarity', 'cut', 'fluorescence'].includes(filterKey)) {
                    syncDiscreteSliderFromState(filterKey, getDiscreteValuesForFilter(filterKey));
                } else if (filterKey === 'lab') {
                    renderLabOptions();
                } else if (filterKey === 'shape') {
                    const container = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-shapes');
                    if (container) {
                        container.querySelectorAll('.diamond-filter-shape').forEach((button) => {
                            if (!button.classList.contains('is-locked')) {
                                setButtonState(button, false);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    syncLockedShapeFilter(getBaseSearchParams());
                }
            } else if (filterKey === 'lot_number') {
                diamondFilterState.lot_number = '';
                const lotInput = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-lot-number');
                if (lotInput) {
                    lotInput.value = '';
                }
            } else if (['carat', 'cost', 'length', 'width', 'ratio'].includes(filterKey)) {
                resetRangeFilter(filterKey);
            }
            refreshDiamondListing();
        }

        /* ============================================================================
           SECTION 8: CONSTRAINT FILTERS
           ============================================================================
           Compatible stone requirements (length/width bounds from center stone)
           ============================================================================ */

        function initializeConstraintFilters() {
            // Parse stonesearch to extract compatible stone constraints
            // This applies the length and width ranges from the product's center stone requirements
            const baseParams = getBaseSearchParams();

            // Extract length range from params
            const lengthParam = baseParams.get('length');
            if (lengthParam) {
                const [minLength, maxLength] = lengthParam.split('-').map(v => parseFloat(v));
                if (!isNaN(minLength) && !isNaN(maxLength)) {
                    diamondFilterState.length = { min: minLength, max: maxLength };

                }
            }

            // Extract width range from params
            const widthParam = baseParams.get('width');
            if (widthParam) {
                const [minWidth, maxWidth] = widthParam.split('-').map(v => parseFloat(v));
                if (!isNaN(minWidth) && !isNaN(maxWidth)) {
                    diamondFilterState.width = { min: minWidth, max: maxWidth };

                }
            }

            // Extract shape from params
            const shapeParam = baseParams.get('shape');
            if (shapeParam) {
                const shapes = shapeParam.split(',');
                shapes.forEach(shape => {
                    if (shape.trim()) {
                        diamondFilterState.shape.add(shape.trim());
                    }
                });

            }
        }

        function resetAllFilters(options = {}) {
            // Always rebuild constraint filters from base search params.
            // This ensures reset/close returns to product-required shape + mm bounds only.
            const baseParams = getBaseSearchParams();
            const constraintLength = parseRangeParam(baseParams.get('length'));
            const constraintWidth = parseRangeParam(baseParams.get('width'));
            const constraintShape = new Set(
                (baseParams.get('shape') || '')
                    .split(',')
                    .map((value) => value.trim())
                    .filter(Boolean)
            );

            clearFilterSet('shape', document.getElementById('diamond-filter-shapes'));
            clearFilterSet('color', document.getElementById('diamond-filter-fancy-colors'));
            clearFilterSet('clarity');
            clearFilterSet('cut');
            clearFilterSet('fluorescence');
            clearFilterSet('lab');

            diamondFilterState.lot_number = '';
            const lotInput = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-lot-number');
            if (lotInput) {
                lotInput.value = '';
            }

            ['carat', 'cost', 'length', 'width', 'ratio'].forEach((rangeKey) => {
                if (rangeKey === 'cost' && !isDiamondPriceEnabled) {
                    return;
                }
                resetRangeFilter(rangeKey);
            });

            // Restore constraint filters
            diamondFilterState.length = constraintLength;
            diamondFilterState.width = constraintWidth;
            diamondFilterState.shape = constraintShape;

            ['carat', 'cost', 'length', 'width', 'ratio'].forEach((rangeKey) => {
                if (rangeKey === 'cost' && !isDiamondPriceEnabled) {
                    return;
                }
                createOrUpdateRangeSlider(rangeKey);
            });

            const sortSelect = document.getElementById('diamond-sort-by');
            if (sortSelect) {
                sortSelect.value = '';
            }
            diamondFilterState.sort_by = '';

            setColorMode('standard', { skipRefresh: true, force: true });
            renderFancyColorOptions();
            renderLabOptions();
            syncFilterOptionsForType(currentType);
			syncLockedShapeFilter(getBaseSearchParams());
			
            renderFilterChips();
            if (!options.skipRefresh) {
                refreshDiamondListing();
            }
        }

        /* ============================================================================
           SECTION 9: DIALOG MANAGEMENT
           ============================================================================
           Showing/hiding dialog, initializing filters, handling dialog events
           ============================================================================ */

        function initDiamondFilters() {
            // Initialize filters from stonesearch constraints (compatible stones)
            initializeConstraintFilters();

            renderShapeButtons();
            syncFilterOptionsForType(currentType);
            syncLockedShapeFilter(getBaseSearchParams());

            ['carat', 'cost', 'length', 'width', 'ratio'].forEach((rangeKey) => {
                if (rangeKey === 'cost' && !isDiamondPriceEnabled) {
                    return;
                }
                createOrUpdateRangeSlider(rangeKey);
                const minInput = document.getElementById(`diamond-${rangeKey}-min`);
                const maxInput = document.getElementById(`diamond-${rangeKey}-max`);
                if (minInput) {
                    minInput.addEventListener('change', () => handleRangeInputChange(rangeKey));
                }
                if (maxInput) {
                    maxInput.addEventListener('change', () => handleRangeInputChange(rangeKey));
                }
            });

            const colorTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.diamond-color-tab');
            colorTabs.forEach((tab) => {
                tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const mode = tab.getAttribute('data-color-mode');
                    if (mode) {
                        setColorMode(mode);
                    }
                });
            });

            const shapeClear = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-shape-clear');
            if (shapeClear) {
                shapeClear.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    clearFilterSet('shape', document.getElementById('diamond-filter-shapes'));
                    syncLockedShapeFilter(getBaseSearchParams());
                    refreshDiamondListing();
                });
            }

            const lotInput = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-lot-number');
            const lotButton = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-lot-button');
            if (lotInput) {
                lotInput.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
                    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        diamondFilterState.lot_number = lotInput.value.trim();
                        refreshDiamondListing();
                    }
                });
            }
            if (lotButton) {
                lotButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    diamondFilterState.lot_number = lotInput ? lotInput.value.trim() : '';
                    refreshDiamondListing();
                });
            }

            const sortSelect = document.getElementById('diamond-sort-by');
            if (sortSelect) {
                sortSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
                    diamondFilterState.sort_by = sortSelect.value;
                    refreshDiamondListing();
                });
            }

            const itemsPerPageSelect = document.getElementById('diamond-items-per-page');
            if (itemsPerPageSelect) {
                itemsPerPageSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
                    limit = parseInt(itemsPerPageSelect.value);
                    page = 1;
                    refreshDiamondListing();
                });
            }

            const showAllShapesBtn = document.getElementById('diamond-show-all-shapes');
            if (showAllShapesBtn) {
                showAllShapesBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    showAllShapes = !showAllShapes;
                    renderShapeButtons();
                });
            }

            const resetButton = document.getElementById('diamond-filters-reset');
            if (resetButton) {
                resetButton.addEventListener('click', resetAllFilters);
            }

            const toggleButton = document.getElementById('diamond-filter-toggle');
            const filterPanel = document.getElementById('diamond-filters-panel');
            if (toggleButton && filterPanel) {
                toggleButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const isHidden = filterPanel.classList.contains('hidden');
                    setDiamondFilterPanelVisibility(isHidden);
                });
                setDiamondFilterPanelVisibility(true);
            }


            const mobileApplyFiltersBtn = document.getElementById('diamond-apply-filters');

            if (mobileApplyFiltersBtn && toggleButton) {
                mobileApplyFiltersBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    toggleButton.click();
                });
            }

            const mobileCloseFiltersBtn = document.getElementById('diamond-close-filters');

            if (mobileCloseFiltersBtn && toggleButton) {
                mobileCloseFiltersBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    toggleButton.click();
                });
            }


            renderFancyColorOptions();
            renderLabOptions();
            renderFilterChips();

            if (!window.__diamondDiscreteSeparatorBound) {
                window.__diamondDiscreteSeparatorBound = true;
                window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.diamond-slider.is-discrete').forEach((slider) => {
                        updateDiscreteSeparatorCount(slider);
                    });
                });
            }

            const typeButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.diamond-type-button');
            typeButtons.forEach((button) => {
                button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const type = button.getAttribute('data-type');
                    if (type) {
                        setDiamondType(type);
                    }
                });
            });
            updateDiamondTypeUI(currentType);
        }

        function isDiamondListingOpen() {
            const dialog = document.getElementById('select-center-stone-dialog');
            const listingStep = document.getElementById('center-stone-dialog-diamond-listing-step');
            if (!dialog || !listingStep) {
                return false;
            }
            return !dialog.classList.contains('hidden') && !listingStep.classList.contains('hidden');
        }

        const storedType = getStoredDiamondType();
        if (storedType) {
            currentType = storedType;
        }
        window.resetCenterStoneDialogFilters = function resetCenterStoneDialogFilters() {
            page = 1;
            pendingDialogFilterReset = true;
        };
        initDiamondFilters();
        showDiamondListing(currentType);

        function showDiamondListing(type) {
            if (!isDiamondListingOpen()) {
                return;
            }
            if (pendingDialogFilterReset) {
                pendingDialogFilterReset = false;
                resetAllFilters({ skipRefresh: true });
                const shouldShowFilterPanel = !window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1023.98px)').matches;
                setDiamondFilterPanelVisibility(shouldShowFilterPanel);
            }
            // Handle type change - reset filters and page when switching types
            if (currentType !== type) {
                page = 1;
                resetAllFilters({ skipRefresh: true });
            }
            currentType = type;
            setStoredDiamondType(type);
            updateDiamondTypeUI(type);

            // Clear old constraint filters before re-initializing with new ones
            diamondFilterState.length = null;
            diamondFilterState.width = null;
            initializeConstraintFilters();

            // Re-render shape buttons against current constraints, then enforce lock state.
            renderShapeButtons();
            syncFilterOptionsForType(type);
            syncLockedShapeFilter(getBaseSearchParams());
				
            renderFilterChips();

            const search = buildDiamondSearchParams();
            search.set('limit', limit);
            search.set('page', page);
            search.set('format', 'json');
			
			//If 2 shapes are available, act on what's selected:
			if (document.querySelectorAll(".diamond-filter-shape:not(.is-locked)").length > 1) {
				let selecteds = document.querySelectorAll(".diamond-filter-shape.is-selected");
				
				if (selecteds.length == 1) {
					search.set('shape', selecteds[0].getAttribute("data-value"));
				}
				else if (!selecteds.length) {
					document.querySelectorAll(".diamond-filter-shape:not(.is-locked)").forEach((entry) => {
						entry.classList.add("is-selected");
					});
				}
			}
			//If only one shape, set the search to always use it:
			else {
				search.set('shape', document.querySelector(".diamond-filter-shape.is-selected").getAttribute("data-value"));
			}

            const jsonpath = `/api/diamonds/${type}/?${search.toString()}`;
            const requestId = ++listingRequestId;
            setListingBusy(true);
            setListingState('loading');
            renderSkeletonRows(Math.min(limit, 8));

            fetch(jsonpath)
                .then(response => response.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (requestId !== listingRequestId) {
                        return;
                    }

                    /* ================================================================
                       SECTION 10: RESULTS RENDERING
                       Displaying diamonds, updating counts, pagination
                       ================================================================ */

                    const allResultBtn = document.getElementById('diamond-all-results');
                    if (allResultBtn && data?.count?.filtered != null) {
                        allResultBtn.textContent = `${data.count.filtered} Results`;
                    }

                    updateRangeDefaultsFromResponse(data);
                    ['carat', 'cost', 'length', 'width', 'ratio'].forEach((rangeKey) => {
                        if (rangeKey === 'cost' && !isDiamondPriceEnabled) {
                            return;
                        }
                        createOrUpdateRangeSlider(rangeKey);
                    });
                    renderFilterChips();

                    const tableBody = document.querySelector('#center-stone-listing-table tbody');
                    if (!tableBody) {
                        return;
                    }

                    const diamonds = data.diamonds || [];
                    renderLabOptions();
                    // updateLabAvailability(currentType);
                    if (!diamonds.length) {
                        tableBody.innerHTML = '';
                        const activeChipCount = document.querySelectorAll('#diamond-filter-chips .diamond-filter-chip:not(.diamond-filter-chip--locked)').length;
                        if (activeChipCount) {
                            setListingState('empty', {
                                title: 'No results match your filters.',
                                message: 'Try clearing or adjusting a few filters to see more diamonds.'
                            });
                        } else {
                            setListingState('empty');
                        }
                        const pag = data.pagination || { page: page, total_pages: 1 };
                        page = pag.page || page;
                        renderPagination(page, pag.total_pages || 1);
                        const scrollContainer = document.querySelector('#center-stone-listing-table .overflow-auto');
                        if (scrollContainer) scrollContainer.scrollTop = 0;
                        return;
                    }

                    const loginHref = `${loginBaseUrl}?next=${encodeURIComponent(location.pathname + location.search)}`;
                    const rows = diamonds.map((diamond, index) => {
                        const measurementValue = String(diamond.measurement || '').replaceAll('mm', '');
                        const depthValue = diamond.depth_percent ? `${diamond.depth_percent}%` : '';
                        const culetValue = diamond.culet ? diamond.culet : 'None';
                        const symmetryValue = diamond.symmetry ? diamond.symmetry : 'None';
                        const tableValue = diamond.table_percent ? diamond.table_percent : 'None';
                        const polishValue = diamond.polish ? diamond.polish : 'None';
                        const fluorescenceValue = diamond.fluorescence ? diamond.fluorescence : 'None';
                        const girdleValue = diamond.girdle ? diamond.girdle : 'None';
                        const memoAction = isDiamondPriceEnabled ? `href="javascript:;" onclick='cartadd("${diamond.lot_number}", this)'` : `href="${loginHref}"`;
                        const memoLabel = isDiamondPriceEnabled ? "Send on Memo" : "Log in to Order";
                        const priceCell = isDiamondPriceEnabled ? `$${diamond.price}` : `<a href="${loginHref}" class="text-slate-500 underline">Login</a>`;
                        const centerAction = isDiamondPriceEnabled ? `href="javascript:;" onclick="applyCenterStoneSelection('${diamond.lot_number}')"` : `href="${loginHref}"`;
                        const centerLabel = isDiamondPriceEnabled ? "Set as a Center" : "Log in to Set as a Center";

                        let videoUrl = null;
                        if (diamond.vision360_url && diamond.vision360_url.includes("video.diamondasset.in")) {
                            videoUrl = diamond.vision360_url;
                        }

                        if (diamond.vision360_url && !diamond.vision360_url.includes("video.diamondasset.in")) {
                            videoUrl = diamond.vision360_url + '?btn=0&z=0&zoomslide=0&isBorderRadius=0&sm=0&sv=0&v=4&watermark=R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw'
                        }

                        return `
                        <tr 
                        class="border-b border-gray-200 center-diamond-select-item cursor-pointer diamond-row font-normal" 
                        lot-number="${diamond.lot_number}"
                        data-lot-number="${diamond.lot_number}"
                        >
                            <td class="w-14 px-2 py-2 align-middle">
                                <div class="flex justify-center items-center">
                                    <img 
                                    class="w-8 h-8" 
                                    alt="Round" 
                                    src="/static/assets/icons/${diamond.shape}.svg" 
                                    title="${diamond.shape}" >
                                </div>
                            </td>

                            <td class="w-44 px-2 py-2 align-middle">
                                <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); copytoclipboard(this.textContent.trim())" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 h-5 px-2 py-1 bg-gray-200 rounded-[50px] max-w-full" style="cursor: copy" title="${diamond.lot_number}">
                                    <span class="text-xs font-['Lato'] text-slate-500 font-bold whitespace-nowrap">${diamond.lot_number}</span>
                                    <svg class="shrink-0" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                        <path d="M6.47435 13.2708H4.02435C1.74352 13.2708 0.728516 12.2558 0.728516 9.97501V7.52501C0.728516 5.24417 1.74352 4.22917 4.02435 4.22917H6.47435C8.75518 4.22917 9.77018 5.24417 9.77018 7.52501V9.97501C9.77018 12.2558 8.75518 13.2708 6.47435 13.2708ZM4.02435 5.10417C2.21602 5.10417 1.60352 5.71667 1.60352 7.52501V9.97501C1.60352 11.7833 2.21602 12.3958 4.02435 12.3958H6.47435C8.28268 12.3958 8.89518 11.7833 8.89518 9.97501V7.52501C8.89518 5.71667 8.28268 5.10417 6.47435 5.10417H4.02435Z" fill="#1D2940"/>
                                        <path d="M9.97435 9.77084H9.33268C9.09352 9.77084 8.89518 9.57251 8.89518 9.33334V7.52501C8.89518 5.71667 8.28268 5.10417 6.47435 5.10417H4.66602C4.42685 5.10417 4.22852 4.90584 4.22852 4.66667V4.02501C4.22852 1.74417 5.24352 0.729172 7.52435 0.729172H9.97435C12.2552 0.729172 13.2702 1.74417 13.2702 4.02501V6.47501C13.2702 8.75584 12.2552 9.77084 9.97435 9.77084ZM9.77018 8.89584H9.97435C11.7827 8.89584 12.3952 8.28334 12.3952 6.47501V4.02501C12.3952 2.21667 11.7827 1.60417 9.97435 1.60417H7.52435C5.71602 1.60417 5.10352 2.21667 5.10352 4.02501V4.22917H6.47435C8.75518 4.22917 9.77018 5.24417 9.77018 7.52501V8.89584Z" fill="#1D2940"/>
                                    </svg>
                                </button>
                            </td>

                            <td class="w-20 px-2 py-2 align-middle text-sm font-['Lato'] text-slate-800">${diamond.carat}</td>

                            <td class="px-2 py-2 align-middle text-sm font-['Lato'] text-slate-800">
                                ${measurementValue}

                    const pag = data.pagination || { page: page, total_pages: 1 };
                    page = pag.page || page;
                    renderPagination(page, pag.total_pages || 1);

                    const scrollContainer = document.querySelector('#center-stone-listing-table .overflow-auto');
                    if (scrollContainer) scrollContainer.scrollTop = 0;
