                    console.error(error);
                    const tableBody = document.querySelector('#center-stone-listing-table tbody');
                    if (tableBody) {
                        tableBody.innerHTML = '';
                    }
                    setListingState('error');
                })
                .finally(() => {
                    if (requestId !== listingRequestId) {
                        return;
                    }
                    setListingBusy(false);
                });
        }

        function renderPagination(currentPage, totalPages) {
            const prevBtn = document.getElementById('diamond-pagination-prev');
            const nextBtn = document.getElementById('diamond-pagination-next');
            const pagesWrap = document.getElementById('diamond-pagination-pages');

            if (!prevBtn || !nextBtn || !pagesWrap) return;

            pagesWrap.innerHTML = '';

            // Prev state
            setArrowDisabled(prevBtn, currentPage <= 1);
            prevBtn.onclick = () => {
                if (currentPage <= 1) return;
                page = currentPage - 1;
                showDiamondListing(currentType);
            };

            // Next state
            setArrowDisabled(nextBtn, currentPage >= totalPages);
            nextBtn.onclick = () => {
                if (currentPage >= totalPages) return;
                page = currentPage + 1;
                showDiamondListing(currentType);
            };

            const pageItems = buildPageItems(currentPage, totalPages);

            for (const it of pageItems) {
                if (it === '...') {
                    pagesWrap.appendChild(createEllipsisItem());
                } else {
                    pagesWrap.appendChild(createPageItem(it, it === currentPage));
                }
            }
        }

        function setArrowDisabled(containerDiv, disabled) {
            containerDiv.style.pointerEvents = disabled ? 'none' : 'auto';
            containerDiv.style.opacity = disabled ? '0.5' : '1';

        }

        function buildPageItems(current, total) {
            if (total <= 6) {
                return Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) => i + 1);
            }

            const items = [];
            const left = Math.max(2, current - 1);
            const right = Math.min(total - 1, current + 1);

            items.push(1);

            if (left > 2) items.push('...');

            for (let p = left; p <= right; p++) items.push(p);

            if (right < total - 1) items.push('...');

            items.push(total);

            if (current === 1) {
                return [1, 2, 3, 4, '...', total];
            }
            if (current === 2) {
                return [1, 2, 3, 4, '...', total];
            }
            if (current === total) {
                return [1, '...', total - 3, total - 2, total - 1, total];
            }
            if (current === total - 1) {
                return [1, '...', total - 3, total - 2, total - 1, total];
            }

            return items;
        }

        function createPageItem(pageNumber, active) {
            const outer = document.createElement('div');

            outer.setAttribute('data-property-1', active ? 'choose' : 'Default');
            outer.className = `w-8 h-8 px-4 py-2 ${active ? 'bg-slate-500' : 'bg-white'} flex justify-center items-center gap-[5px] diamond-pagination-item`;

            const inner = document.createElement('div');
            inner.className = `justify-center ${active ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-800'} text-sm font-bold font-['Lato']`;
            inner.textContent = String(pageNumber);

            outer.appendChild(inner);

            outer.style.cursor = 'pointer';
            outer.onclick = () => {
                if (page === pageNumber) return;
                page = pageNumber;
                showDiamondListing(currentType);
            };

            return outer;
        }

        function createEllipsisItem() {
            const outer = document.createElement('div');
            outer.setAttribute('data-property-1', 'Default');
            outer.className = `w-8 h-8 px-4 py-2 bg-white flex justify-center items-center gap-[5px]`;

            const inner = document.createElement('div');
            inner.className = `justify-center text-slate-800 text-sm font-bold font-['Lato']`;
            inner.textContent = '...';

            outer.appendChild(inner);
            outer.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
            return outer;
        }
    </script>

</div>

<!-- ============================================================================
     SECTION 11: CART OPERATIONS
     ============================================================================
     Add to cart, remove from cart, cart management
     ============================================================================ -->
<script>
    function getMemoLabelNode(btn) {
        if (!btn) return null;
        return btn.querySelector("[data-memo-label]");
    }

    function setMemoButtonState(btn, state, lotNum, cartId) {
        const labelNode = getMemoLabelNode(btn);
        const labelText = state === "remove" ? "Remove from Cart" : "Send on Memo";

        if (labelNode) {
            labelNode.textContent = labelText;
        } else if (btn) {
            btn.textContent = labelText;
        }

        if (!btn) return;

        if (state === "remove") {
            if (typeof cartId !== "undefined") {
                btn.setAttribute("onclick", `cartremove("${lotNum}", this, ${cartId})`);
                btn.dataset.cartId = String(cartId);
            }
        } else {
            btn.setAttribute("onclick", `cartadd("${lotNum}", this)`);
            btn.dataset.cartId = "";
        }
    }

    function cartadd(lot_num, btn) {
        if (typeof nocart == "undefined") {
            btn.inert = true;
            //Change the hidden form's value to the lot number:
            let form = document.querySelector('#diamond2cart');
            form.children[0].value = lot_num;

            //Submit the form data:
            fetch(carturl, {
                method: "POST",
                body: new FormData(form)
            })
                .then((response) => {
                    if (response.ok) {
                        sysalert("Diamond " + lot_num + " added to cart.", 'good');
                        response.json().then((json) => {
                            console.log(json);
                            //If store-embedded iframe:
                            if (carturl !== "/api/cartdiamonditem/") {
                                btn.removeAttribute("onclick");
                                const labelNode = getMemoLabelNode(btn);
                                if (labelNode) {
                                    labelNode.textContent = "Added to Cart";
                                } else {
                                    btn.textContent = "Added to Cart";
                                }
                                //btn.inert = true;
                            }
                            else {
                                setMemoButtonState(btn, "remove", lot_num, json.id);
                                btn.inert = false;
                                //Increment cart number in the header:
                                refreshcartcount('glow');
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    else {
                        try {
                            response.json().then((json) => { sysalert(json.detail, 'bad'); });
                        }
                        catch {
                            sysalert('There was an error adding Diamond #' + lot_num + ' to the cart. Please check your connection and try again.', 'bad');
                        }
                        btn.inert = false;
                    }
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    sysalert("An error occurred. Please check your connection and try again.", 'bad');
                    console.error(error);
                    btn.inert = false;
                });
        }
        else {
            sysalert("Please contact us to order this item manually.", "");
        }
    }

    function cartremove(lot_num, btn, id) {
        btn.inert = true;
        //Change the hidden form's value to the lot number:
        let form = document.querySelector('#diamond2cart');

        //Submit the form data:
        fetch(carturl + "?id=" + id, {
            method: "DELETE",
            headers: { "X-CSRFToken": form.children[1].value }
        })
            .then((response) => {
                if (response.ok) {
                    sysalert("Diamond " + lot_num + " removed from cart.", 'good');
                    //Decrement cart number in the header:
                    refreshcartcount();
                    //Swap the button functionality:
                    setMemoButtonState(btn, "add", lot_num);
                }
                else {
                    try {
                        response.json().then((json) => { sysalert(json.detail, 'bad'); });
                    }
                    catch {
                        sysalert('There was an error removing Diamond #' + lot_num + ' from the cart. Please check your connection and try again.', 'bad');
                    }
                }
                btn.inert = false;
            })
            .catch(error => {
                sysalert("An error occurred. Please check your connection and try again.", 'bad');
                console.error(error);
                btn.inert = false;
            });
    }
</script>

<script>
    function toggleDiamondDetails(lotNumber) {


        const detailsSection = document.getElementById(`diamond-details-${lotNumber}`);

        const isHidden = detailsSection.classList.contains("hidden");

        if (isHidden) {
            detailsSection.classList.remove("hidden");
            detailsSection.classList.add("table-row");
        } else {
            detailsSection.classList.remove("table-row");
            detailsSection.classList.add("hidden");
        }

    }
</script>

            img.style.width = "100%";
            img.style.display = "block";
            imgHolder.appendChild(img);

            if (fullscreenImgLink) fullscreenImgLink.href = src;

        } else {
            imgHolder.innerHTML = "";
            if (fullscreenImgLink) fullscreenImgLink.removeAttribute("href");
        }


        // ===== Video / iframe =====
        const pageIframe = document.getElementById(`stone-preview-iframe-${lotnum}`);

                iframe.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");

            popup("popdiamondmedia");

        }

<script>
    const showAutoSelectStoneLoading = () => {
        const overlay = document.getElementById("auto-select-stone-loading-overlay");
        if (overlay) {
            overlay.classList.add("active");
        }
    }
    const hideAutoSelectStoneLoading = () => {
        const overlay = document.getElementById("auto-select-stone-loading-overlay");
        if (overlay) {
            overlay.classList.remove("active");
        }
    }
    const submitAutoSelectCenterStone = () => {
        const lotNumber = document.getElementById('auto-select-stone-lot-number');
        const selected = lotNumber ? lotNumber.innerText.trim() : "";

        if (!selected) {
            return;
        }

        if (typeof applyCenterStoneSelection === "function") {
            applyCenterStoneSelection(selected);
            return;
        }

        const url = new URL(location.href);
        url.searchParams.set('center', selected);
        location.href = url.toString();
    }   
    // try again button
    const retryAutoSelectCenterStone = () => {
        if (typeof window.showAutoSelectStone === "function") {
            showAutoSelectStoneLoading();
            window.showAutoSelectStone(null)?.finally(() => {
                hideAutoSelectStoneLoading();
            });
        }
    }
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        window.showAutoSelectStoneLoading = showAutoSelectStoneLoading;
        window.hideAutoSelectStoneLoading = hideAutoSelectStoneLoading;
    });
</script>

</div>

<!-- show/hide select center stone dialog -->
<script>
    const toggleSelectCenterStoneDialog = () => {
        const selectCenterStoneDialog = document.getElementById('select-center-stone-dialog');
        if (!selectCenterStoneDialog) {
            return;
        }

        const isHidden = selectCenterStoneDialog.classList.contains('hidden')

        if (isHidden) {
            selectCenterStoneDialog.classList.remove('hidden');
            selectCenterStoneDialog.classList.add('flex');
        } else {
            if (typeof window.resetCenterStoneDialogFilters === 'function') {
                window.resetCenterStoneDialogFilters();
            }
            selectCenterStoneDialog.classList.add('hidden');
            selectCenterStoneDialog.classList.remove('flex');


            ['#center-stone-dialog-review-auto-select-step',
                '#center-stone-dialog-diamond-listing-step',
                '#center-stone-dialog-select-category-step'
            ].forEach(stepSelector => {
                const step = document.querySelector(stepSelector);
                if (step) {
                    step.classList.add('hidden');
                    step.classList.remove('flex');
                }
            });

            const autoSelectSteps = selectCenterStoneDialog.querySelectorAll(
                '.center-stone-dialog-review-auto-select-step'
            );
            autoSelectSteps.forEach((step) => {
                step.classList.add('hidden');
                step.classList.remove('flex');
            });
        }
    }


    const openCenterStoneDialog = () => {
        toggleSelectCenterStoneDialog();
        const selectCategoryStep = document.getElementById('center-stone-dialog-select-category-step');
        if (selectCategoryStep) {
            selectCategoryStep.classList.remove('hidden');
            selectCategoryStep.classList.add('flex');
			document.querySelectorAll('#psd, #psd2').forEach((entry) => { entry.style.display = "none"; });
        }
    };

    window.toggleSelectCenterStoneDialog = toggleSelectCenterStoneDialog;
    window.openCenterStoneDialog = openCenterStoneDialog;
    window.centerStoneSelectionTarget = window.centerStoneSelectionTarget || "center";

    document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const trigger = event.target.closest('#selectStone, #replaceStone, #selectStone2, #replaceStone2');
        if (!trigger) {
            return;
        }
        event.preventDefault();
        const target = trigger.closest('#selectStone2, #replaceStone2') ? 'center2' : 'center';
        window.centerStoneSelectionTarget = target;
        const title = document.getElementById('center-stone-dialog-title');
        if (title) {
            title.textContent = target === 'center2' ? 'Matching Diamond Selection' : 'Center Diamond Selection';
        }
        const categoryTitle = document.getElementById('center-stone-category-title');
        if (categoryTitle) {
            categoryTitle.textContent = target === 'center2' ? 'Matching Diamond Selection' : 'Center Diamond Selection';
        }
        if (typeof window.refreshCenterStoneConstraints === 'function') {
            window.refreshCenterStoneConstraints();
        }
        openCenterStoneDialog();
    });
</script>

  </div>

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const backToTops = document.getElementsByClassName("backToTop");

    Array.from(backToTops).map((backToTop) => {
      if (!backToTop) return;

      backToTop.style.cursor = "pointer";

      backToTop.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();

        window.scrollTo({
          top: 0,
          behavior: "smooth",
        });
      });
    });
  });
  function joinmailinglistV2() {
	//
	showToastCommon('This functionality is coming soon! For now, please contact a representative to join our newsletter.', 'info'); return;
	//
	
	const form = document.querySelector("#newsletterform");
	
	/*if (!form.querySelector("input").checkValidity()) {
		showToastCommon('Please enter a valid email.', 'info');
		return;
	}*/

	const fd = new FormData(form);
	fetch('/api/form_submission/', {
		method: "POST",
		body: fd,
	}).then(async (response) => {
		if (response.ok) {
			form.inert = false;
			form.reset();
			form.querySelector("input").placeholder = "Thank you!";
			showToastCommon('Request recieved. Thank you for signing up!', 'good');
			return;
		}
	})
	.catch((error) => {
		form.inert = false;
		showToastCommon('An error has occured. Please try again.', 'info');
	});
  }
  
  let newslettered = false;
  
  function addcaptcha() {
	const nform = document.querySelector("#newsletterform");
	// If the page doen't have captchasubmit.js, add it here:
	if (typeof formactions == "undefined") {
		let script = document.createElement('script');
		script.src = 'https://www.overnightmountings.com/static/captchasubmit.js?v=1.1';
		script.async = true; 
		script.defer = true; 
		nform.appendChild(script);
	}
	// Only add these if a recaptcha doesn't already exist on this page:
	if (!document.querySelector(".g-recaptcha"/*, .grecaptcha-badge*/)) {
		let script2 = document.createElement('script');
		script2.src = 'https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js?badge=bottomright';
		script2.async = true; 
		script2.defer = true; 
		nform.appendChild(script2);
		
		let gdiv = document.createElement('div');
		nform.appendChild(gdiv);
		gdiv.outerHTML = '<div class="g-recaptcha" data-sitekey="6LeeE_ErAAAAAAg6mI0l4nS005Ca31lsUP2eWQX4" data-callback="onSubmit" data-size="invisible"></div>';
	}
	else {
		let grecap = document.querySelector(".g-recaptcha"/*, .grecaptcha-badge*/);
		if (grecap.parentElement !== nform) {
			grecap.parentElement.classList.add("movedcaptcha");
			grecap.classList.add("moved");
			nform.appendChild(grecap);
		}
		
		if (nform.inert) {
			newslettered = true;
			setTimeout(() => { formactions(nform) }, 250)
		}
	}
  }
</script>

	function loadScript(src) {
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			const s = document.createElement("script");
			s.src = src;
			s.onload = resolve;
			s.onerror = reject;
			document.body.appendChild(s);
		});
	}

    <script type="module" src="/static/js/home/bootstrap.js"></script>
    <script>
	
	
    (function() {
        var COOKIE_NAME = 'omi_announcement_closed';
        var COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60;
        var el = document.getElementById('header-announcement');
        var closeBtn = document.getElementById('header-announcement-close');
        if (!el) return;
        function getCookie(name) {
            var match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(?:^|; )' + name.replace(/([.$?*|{}()[\]\\/+^])/g, '\\$1') + '=([^;]*)'));
            return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
        }
        function setCookie(name, value, maxAge) {
            document.cookie = name + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value) + '; max-age=' + maxAge + '; path=/; SameSite=Lax';
        }
        function hideAnnouncement() {
            el.style.display = 'none';
            window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
        }
        if (getCookie(COOKIE_NAME)) {
            hideAnnouncement();
        }
        if (closeBtn) {
            closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                setCookie(COOKIE_NAME, '1', COOKIE_MAX_AGE);
                hideAnnouncement();
            });
        }
    })();
    </script>
